name: Sauptika Parva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste sahitA vIrAH prayAtA dakShiNAmukhAH |
upAstamayavelAyAM shibirAbhyAshamAgatAH
shlokas.2:
vimuchya vAhA.nstvaritA bhItAH samabhava.nstadA |
gahanaM deshamAsAdya prachChannA nyavishanta te
shlokas.3:
senAniveshamabhito nAtidUramavasthitAH |
nikRRittA nishitaiH shastraiH samantAtkShatavikShatAH
shlokas.4:
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya pANDavAnanvachintayan |
shrutvA cha ninadaM ghoraM pANDavAnAM jayaiShiNAm
shlokas.5:
anusArabhayAdbhItAH prA~NmukhAH prAdravanpunaH |
te muhUrtaM tato gatvA shrAntavAhAH pipAsitAH
shlokas.6:
nAmRRiShyanta maheShvAsAH krodhAmarShavashaM gatAH |
rAj~no vadhena santaptA muhUrtaM samavasthitAH
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ashraddheyamidaM karma kRRitaM bhImena sa~njaya |
yatsa nAgAyutaprANaH putro mama nipAtitaH
shlokas.8:
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM vajrasaMhanano yuvA |
pANDavaiH samare putro nihato mama sa~njaya
shlokas.9:
na diShTamabhyatikrAntuM shakyaM gAvalgaNe naraiH |
yatsametya raNe pArthaiH putro mama nipAtitaH
shlokas.10:
adrisAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM mama sa~njaya |
hataM putrashataM shrutvA yanna dIrNaM sahasradhA
shlokas.11:
kathaM hi vRRiddhamithunaM hataputraM bhaviShyati |
na hyahaM pANDaveyasya viShaye vastumutsahe
shlokas.12:
kathaM rAj~naH pitA bhUtvA svayaM rAjA cha sa~njaya |
preShyabhUtaH pravarteyaM pANDaveyasya shAsanAt
shlokas.13:
Aj~nApya pRRithivIM sarvAM sthitvA mUrdhni cha sa~njaya |
kathamadya bhaviShyAmi preShyabhUto durantakRRit
shlokas.14:
kathaM bhImasya vAkyAni shrotuM shakShyAmi sa~njaya |
yena putrashataM pUrNamekena nihataM mama
shlokas.15:
kRRitaM satyaM vachastasya vidurasya mahAtmanaH |
akurvatA vachastena mama putreNa sa~njaya
shlokas.16:
adharmeNa hate tAta putre duryodhane mama |
kRRitavarmA kRRipo drauNiH kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.17:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
gatvA tu tAvakA rAjannAtidUramavasthitAH |
apashyanta vanaM ghoraM nAnAdrumalatAkulam
shlokas.18:
te muhUrtaM tu vishramya labdhatoyairhayottamaiH |
sUryAstamayavelAyAmAseduH sumahadvanam
shlokas.21:
pravishya tadvanaM ghoraM vIkShamANAH samantataH |
shAkhAsahasrasa~nChannaM nyagrodhaM dadRRishustataH
shlokas.22:
upetya tu tadA rAjannyagrodhaM te mahArathAH |
dadRRishurdvipadAM shreShThAH shreShThaM taM vai vanaspatim
shlokas.23:
te.avatIrya rathebhyastu vipramuchya cha vAjinaH |
upaspRRishya yathAnyAyaM sandhyAmanvAsata prabho
shlokas.24:
tato.astaM parvatashreShThamanuprApte divAkare |
sarvasya jagato dhAtrI sharvarI samapadyata
shlokas.26:
IShachchApi pravalganti ye sattvA rAtrichAriNaH |
divAcharAshcha ye sattvAste nidrAvashamAgatAH
shlokas.27:
rAtri~ncharANAM sattvAnAM ninAdo.abhUtsudAruNaH |
kravyAdAshcha pramuditA ghorA prAptA cha sharvarI
shlokas.28:
tasminrAtrimukhe ghore duHkhashokasamanvitAH |
kRRitavarmA kRRipo drauNirupopavivishuH samam
shlokas.29:
tatropaviShTAH shochanto nyagrodhasya samantataH |
tamevArthamatikrAntaM kurupANDavayoH kShayam
shlokas.30:
nidrayA cha parItA~NgA niShedurdharaNItale |
shrameNa sudRRiDhaM yuktA vikShatA vividhaiH sharaiH
shlokas.31:
tato nidrAvashaM prAptau kRRipabhojau mahArathau |
sukhochitAvaduHkhArhau niShaNNau dharaNItale
tau tu suptau mahArAja shramashokasamanvitau
shlokas.32:
krodhAmarShavashaM prApto droNaputrastu bhArata |
naiva sma sa jagAmAtha nidrAM sarpa iva shvasan
shlokas.33:
na lebhe sa tu nidrAM vai dahyamAno.atimanyunA |
vIkShAM chakre mahAbAhustadvanaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.34:
vIkShamANo vanoddeshaM nAnAsattvairniShevitam |
apashyata mahAbAhurnyagrodhaM vAyasAyutam
shlokas.35:
tatra kAkasahasrANi tAM nishAM paryaNAmayan |
sukhaM svapantaH kauravya pRRithakpRRithagapAshrayAH
shlokas.36:
supteShu teShu kAkeShu visrabdheShu samantataH |
so.apashyatsahasAyAntamulUkaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.37:
mahAsvanaM mahAkAyaM haryakShaM babhrupi~Ngalam |
sudIrghaghoNAnakharaM suparNamiva veginam
shlokas.38:
so.atha shabdaM mRRiduM kRRitvA lIyamAna ivANDajaH |
nyagrodhasya tataH shAkhAM prArthayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.39:
saMnipatya tu shAkhAyAM nyagrodhasya viha~NgamaH |
suptA~njaghAna subahUnvAyasAnvAyasAntakaH
shlokas.40:
keShA~nchidachChinatpakShA~nshirA.nsi cha chakarta ha |
charaNA.nshchaiva keShA~nchidbabha~nja charaNAyudhaH
shlokas.41:
kShaNenAhansa balavAnye.asya dRRiShTipathe sthitAH |
teShAM sharIrAvayavaiH sharIraishcha vishAM pate
nyagrodhamaNDalaM sarvaM sa~nChannaM sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.42:
tA.nstu hatvA tataH kAkAnkaushiko mudito.abhavat |
pratikRRitya yathAkAmaM shatrUNAM shatrusUdanaH
shlokas.43:
taddRRiShTvA sopadhaM karma kaushikena kRRitaM nishi |
tadbhAvakRRitasa~Nkalpo drauNireko vyachintayat
shlokas.44:
upadeshaH kRRito.anena pakShiNA mama sa.nyuge |
shatrUNAM kShapaNe yuktaH prAptakAlashcha me mataH
shlokas.45:
nAdya shakyA mayA hantuM pANDavA jitakAshinaH |
balavantaH kRRitotsAhA labdhalakShAH prahAriNaH
rAj~naH sakAshe teShAM cha pratij~nAto vadho mayA
shlokas.46:
pata~NgAgnisamAM vRRittimAsthAyAtmavinAshinIm |
nyAyato yudhyamAnasya prANatyAgo na sa.nshayaH
ChadmanA tu bhavetsiddhiH shatrUNAM cha kShayo mahAn
shlokas.47:
tatra sa.nshayitAdarthAdyo.artho niHsa.nshayo bhavet |
taM janA bahu manyante ye.arthashAstravishAradAH
shlokas.48:
yachchApyatra bhavedvAchyaM garhitaM lokaninditam |
kartavyaM tanmanuShyeNa kShatradharmeNa vartatA
shlokas.49:
ninditAni cha sarvANi kutsitAni pade pade |
sopadhAni kRRitAnyeva pANDavairakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.50:
asminnarthe purA gItau shrUyete dharmachintakaiH |
shlokau nyAyamavekShadbhistattvArthaM tattvadarshibhiH
shlokas.51:
parishrAnte vidIrNe cha bhu~njAne chApi shatrubhiH |
prasthAne cha praveshe cha prahartavyaM riporbalam
shlokas.52:
nidrArtamardharAtre cha tathA naShTapraNAyakam |
bhinnayodhaM balaM yachcha dvidhA yuktaM cha yadbhavet
shlokas.53:
ityevaM nishchayaM chakre suptAnAM yudhi mAraNe |
pANDUnAM saha pA~nchAlairdroNaputraH pratApavAn
shlokas.54:
sa krUrAM matimAsthAya vinishchitya muhurmuhuH |
suptau prAbodhayattau tu mAtulaM bhojameva cha
shlokas.55:
nottaraM pratipede cha tatra yuktaM hriyA vRRitaH |
sa muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA bAShpavihvalamabravIt
shlokas.56:
hato duryodhano rAjA ekavIro mahAbalaH |
yasyArthe vairamasmAbhirAsaktaM pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.57:
ekAkI bahubhiH kShudrairAhave shuddhavikramaH |
pAtito bhImasenena ekAdashachamUpatiH
shlokas.58:
vRRikodareNa kShudreNa sunRRisha.nsamidaM kRRitam |
mUrdhAbhiShiktasya shiraH pAdena parimRRidnatA
shlokas.59:
vinardanti sma pA~nchAlAH kShveDanti cha hasanti cha |
dhamanti sha~NkhA~nshatasho hRRiShTA ghnanti cha dundubhIn
shlokas.60:
vAditraghoShastumulo vimishraH sha~NkhanisvanaiH |
anilenerito ghoro dishaH pUrayatIva hi
shlokas.61:
ashvAnAM heShamANAnAM gajAnAM chaiva bRRiMhatAm |
siMhanAdashcha shUrANAM shrUyate sumahAnayam
shlokas.62:
dishaM prAchIM samAshritya hRRiShTAnAM garjatAM bhRRisham |
rathanemisvanAshchaiva shrUyante lomaharShaNAH
shlokas.63:
pANDavairdhArtarAShTrANAM yadidaM kadanaM kRRitam |
vayameva trayaH shiShTAstasminmahati vaishase
shlokas.64:
kechinnAgashataprANAH kechitsarvAstrakovidAH |
nihatAH pANDaveyaiH sma manye kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.65:
evametena bhAvyaM hi nUnaM kAryeNa tattvataH |
yathA hyasyedRRishI niShThA kRRite kArye.api duShkare
shlokas.66:
bhavatostu yadi praj~nA na mohAdapachIyate |
vyApanne.asminmahatyarthe yannaH shreyastaduchyatAm

shlokas.1:
kRRipa uvAcha||
shrutaM te vachanaM sarvaM hetuyuktaM mayA vibho |
mamApi tu vachaH ki~nchichChRRiNuShvAdya mahAbhuja
shlokas.2:
AbaddhA mAnuShAH sarve nirbandhAH karmaNordvayoH |
daive puruShakAre cha paraM tAbhyAM na vidyate
shlokas.3:
na hi daivena sidhyanti karmANyekena sattama |
na chApi karmaNaikena dvAbhyAM siddhistu yogataH
shlokas.4:
tAbhyAmubhAbhyAM sarvArthA nibaddhA hyadhamottamAH |
pravRRittAshchaiva dRRishyante nivRRittAshchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
parjanyaH parvate varShankiM nu sAdhayate phalam |
kRRiShTe kShetre tathAvarShankiM nu sAdhayate phalam
shlokas.6:
utthAnaM chApyadaivasya hyanutthAnasya daivatam |
vyarthaM bhavati sarvatra pUrvaM kastatra nishchayaH
shlokas.7:
pravRRiShTe cha yathA deve samyakkShetre cha karShite |
bIjaM mahAguNaM bhUyAttathA siddhirhi mAnuShI
shlokas.8:
tayordaivaM vinishchitya svavashenaiva vartate |
prAj~nAH puruShakAraM tu ghaTante dAkShyamAsthitAH
shlokas.9:
tAbhyAM sarve hi kAryArthA manuShyANAM nararShabha |
vicheShTantashcha dRRishyante nivRRittAshcha tathaiva hi
shlokas.10:
kRRitaH puruShakAraH sanso.api daivena sidhyati |
tathAsya karmaNaH karturabhinirvartate phalam
shlokas.11:
utthAnaM tu manuShyANAM dakShANAM daivavarjitam |
aphalaM dRRishyate loke samyagapyupapAditam
shlokas.12:
tatrAlasA manuShyANAM ye bhavantyamanasvinaH |
utthAnaM te vigarhanti prAj~nAnAM tanna rochate
shlokas.13:
prAyasho hi kRRitaM karma aphalaM dRRishyate bhuvi |
akRRitvA cha punarduHkhaM karma dRRishyenmahAphalam
shlokas.14:
cheShTAmakurva.Nllabhate yadi ki~nchidyadRRichChayA |
yo vA na labhate kRRitvA durdashau tAvubhAvapi
shlokas.15:
shaknoti jIvituM dakSho nAlasaH sukhamedhate |
dRRishyante jIvaloke.asmindakShAH prAyo hitaiShiNaH
shlokas.16:
yadi dakShaH samArambhAtkarmaNAM nAshnute phalam |
nAsya vAchyaM bhavetki~nchittattvaM chApyadhigachChati
shlokas.17:
akRRitvA karma yo loke phalaM vindati viShTitaH |
sa tu vaktavyatAM yAti dveShyo bhavati prAyashaH
shlokas.18:
evametadanAdRRitya vartate yastvato.anyathA |
sa karotyAtmano.anarthAnnaiSha buddhimatAM nayaH
shlokas.19:
hInaM puruShakAreNa yadA daivena vA punaH |
kAraNAbhyAmathaitAbhyAmutthAnamaphalaM bhavet
hInaM puruShakAreNa karma tviha na sidhyati
shlokas.20:
daivatebhyo namaskRRitya yastvarthAnsamyagIhate |
dakSho dAkShiNyasampanno na sa moghaM vihanyate
shlokas.21:
samyagIhA punariyaM yo vRRiddhAnupasevate |
ApRRichChati cha yachChreyaH karoti cha hitaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
utthAyotthAya hi sadA praShTavyA vRRiddhasaMmatAH |
te.asya yoge paraM mUlaM tanmUlA siddhiruchyate
shlokas.23:
vRRiddhAnAM vachanaM shrutvA yo hyutthAnaM prayojayet |
utthAnasya phalaM samyaktadA sa labhate.achirAt
shlokas.24:
rAgAtkrodhAdbhayAllobhAdyo.arthAnIheta mAnavaH |
anIshashchAvamAnI cha sa shIghraM bhrashyate shriyaH
shlokas.25:
so.ayaM duryodhanenArtho lubdhenAdIrghadarshinA |
asamarthya samArabdho mUDhatvAdavichintitaH
shlokas.27:
pUrvamapyatiduHshIlo na dainyaM kartumarhati |
tapatyarthe vipanne hi mitrANAmakRRitaM vachaH
shlokas.28:
anvAvartAmahi vayaM yattu taM pApapUruSham |
asmAnapyanayastasmAtprApto.ayaM dAruNo mahAn
shlokas.29:
anena tu mamAdyApi vyasanenopatApitA |
buddhishchintayataH ki~nchitsvaM shreyo nAvabudhyate
shlokas.30:
muhyatA tu manuShyeNa praShTavyAH suhRRido budhAH |
te cha pRRiShTA yathA brUyustatkartavyaM tathA bhavet
shlokas.31:
te vayaM dhRRitarAShTraM cha gAndhArIM cha sametya ha |
upapRRichChAmahe gatvA viduraM cha mahAmatim
shlokas.32:
te pRRiShTAshcha vadeyuryachChreyo naH samanantaram |
tadasmAbhiH punaH kAryamiti me naiShThikI matiH
shlokas.33:
anArambhAttu kAryANAM nArthaH sampadyate kvachit |
kRRite puruShakAre cha yeShAM kAryaM na sidhyati
daivenopahatAste tu nAtra kAryA vichAraNA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kRRipasya vachanaM shrutvA dharmArthasahitaM shubham |
ashvatthAmA mahArAja duHkhashokasamanvitaH
shlokas.2:
dahyamAnastu shokena pradIptenAgninA yathA |
krUraM manastataH kRRitvA tAvubhau pratyabhAShata
shlokas.3:
puruShe puruShe buddhiH sA sA bhavati shobhanA |
tuShyanti cha pRRithaksarve praj~nayA te svayA svayA
shlokas.4:
sarvo hi manyate loka AtmAnaM buddhimattaram |
sarvasyAtmA bahumataH sarvAtmAnaM prasha.nsati
shlokas.5:
sarvasya hi svakA praj~nA sAdhuvAde pratiShThitA |
parabuddhiM cha nindanti svAM prasha.nsanti chAsakRRit
shlokas.6:
kAraNAntarayogena yoge yeShAM samA matiH |
te.anyonyena cha tuShyanti bahu manyanti chAsakRRit
shlokas.7:
tasyaiva tu manuShyasya sA sA buddhistadA tadA |
kAlayogaviparyAsaM prApyAnyonyaM vipadyate
shlokas.8:
achintyatvAddhi chittAnAM manuShyANAM visheShataH |
chittavaikalyamAsAdya sA sA buddhiH prajAyate
shlokas.9:
yathA hi vaidyaH kushalo j~nAtvA vyAdhiM yathAvidhi |
bheShajaM kurute yogAtprashamArthamihAbhibho
shlokas.10:
evaM kAryasya yogArthaM buddhiM kurvanti mAnavAH |
praj~nayA hi svayA yuktAstAM cha nindanti mAnavAH
shlokas.11:
anyayA yauvane martyo buddhyA bhavati mohitaH |
madhye.anyayA jarAyAM tu so.anyAM rochayate matim
shlokas.12:
vyasanaM vA punarghoraM samRRiddhiM vApi tAdRRishIm |
avApya puruSho bhoja kurute buddhivaikRRitam
shlokas.13:
ekasminneva puruShe sA sA buddhistadA tadA |
bhavatyanityapraj~natvAtsA tasyaiva na rochate
shlokas.14:
nishchitya tu yathApraj~naM yAM matiM sAdhu pashyati |
tasyAM prakurute bhAvaM sA tasyodyogakArikA
shlokas.15:
sarvo hi puruSho bhoja sAdhvetaditi nishchitaH |
kartumArabhate prIto maraNAdiShu karmasu
shlokas.16:
sarve hi yuktiM vij~nAya praj~nAM chApi svakAM narAH |
cheShTante vividhAshcheShTA hitamityeva jAnate
shlokas.17:
upajAtA vyasanajA yeyamadya matirmama |
yuvayostAM pravakShyAmi mama shokavinAshinIm
shlokas.18:
prajApatiH prajAH sRRiShTvA karma tAsu vidhAya cha |
varNe varNe samAdhatta ekaikaM guNavattaram
shlokas.19:
brAhmaNe damamavyagraM kShatriye teja uttamam |
dAkShyaM vaishye cha shUdre cha sarvavarNAnukUlatAm
shlokas.20:
adAnto brAhmaNo.asAdhurnistejAH kShatriyo.adhamaH |
adakSho nindyate vaishyaH shUdrashcha pratikUlavAn
shlokas.21:
so.asmi jAtaH kule shreShThe brAhmaNAnAM supUjite |
mandabhAgyatayAsmyetaM kShatradharmamanu ShThitaH
shlokas.22:
kShatradharmaM viditvAhaM yadi brAhmaNyasa.nshritam |
prakuryAM sumahatkarma na me tatsAdhu saMmatam
shlokas.23:
dhArayitvA dhanurdivyaM divyAnyastrANi chAhave |
pitaraM nihataM dRRiShTvA kiM nu vakShyAmi sa.nsadi
shlokas.24:
so.ahamadya yathAkAmaM kShatradharmamupAsya tam |
gantAsmi padavIM rAj~naH pitushchApi mahAdyuteH
shlokas.25:
adya svapsyanti pA~nchAlA vishvastA jitakAshinaH |
vimuktayugyakavachA harSheNa cha samanvitAH
vayaM jitA matAshchaiShAM shrAntA vyAyamanena cha
shlokas.26:
teShAM nishi prasuptAnAM svasthAnAM shibire svake |
avaskandaM kariShyAmi shibirasyAdya duShkaram
shlokas.27:
tAnavaskandya shibire pretabhUtAnvichetasaH |
sUdayiShyAmi vikramya maghavAniva dAnavAn
shlokas.28:
adya tAnsahitAnsarvAndhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAn |
sUdayiShyAmi vikramya kakShaM dIpta ivAnalaH
nihatya chaiva pA~nchAlA~nshAntiM labdhAsmi sattama
shlokas.29:
pA~nchAleShu chariShyAmi sUdayannadya sa.nyuge |
pinAkapANiH sa~NkruddhaH svayaM rudraH pashuShviva
shlokas.30:
adyAhaM sarvapA~nchAlAnnihatya cha nikRRitya cha |
ardayiShyAmi sa~Nkruddho raNe pANDusutA.nstathA
shlokas.31:
adyAhaM sarvapA~nchAlaiH kRRitvA bhUmiM sharIriNIm |
prahRRityaikaikashastebhyo bhaviShyAmyanRRiNaH pituH
shlokas.32:
duryodhanasya karNasya bhIShmasaindhavayorapi |
gamayiShyAmi pA~nchAlAnpadavImadya durgamAm
shlokas.33:
adya pA~nchAlarAjasya dhRRiShTadyumnasya vai nishi |
virAtre pramathiShyAmi pashoriva shiro balAt
shlokas.34:
adya pA~nchAlapANDUnAM shayitAnAtmajAnnishi |
khaDgena nishitenAjau pramathiShyAmi gautama
shlokas.35:
adya pA~nchAlasenAM tAM nihatya nishi sauptike |
kRRitakRRityaH sukhI chaiva bhaviShyAmi mahAmate

shlokas.1:
kRRipa uvAcha||
diShTyA te pratikartavye matirjAteyamachyuta |
na tvA vArayituM shakto vajrapANirapi svayam
shlokas.2:
anuyAsyAvahe tvAM tu prabhAte sahitAvubhau |
adya rAtrau vishramasva vimuktakavachadhvajaH
shlokas.3:
ahaM tvAmanuyAsyAmi kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
parAnabhimukhaM yAntaM rathAvAsthAya da.nshitau
shlokas.4:
AvAbhyAM sahitaH shatrU~nshvo.asi hantA samAgame |
vikramya rathinAM shreShTha pA~nchAlAnsapadAnugAn
shlokas.5:
shaktastvamasi vikrAntuM vishramasva nishAmimAm |
chiraM te jAgratastAta svapa tAvannishAmimAm
shlokas.6:
vishrAntashcha vinidrashcha svasthachittashcha mAnada |
sametya samare shatrUnvadhiShyasi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
na hi tvA rathinAM shreShTha pragRRihItavarAyudham |
jetumutsahate kashchidapi deveShu pAvakiH
shlokas.8:
kRRipeNa sahitaM yAntaM yuktaM cha kRRitavarmaNA |
ko drauNiM yudhi sa.nrabdhaM yodhayedapi devarAT
shlokas.9:
te vayaM parivishrAntA vinidrA vigatajvarAH |
prabhAtAyAM rajanyAM vai nihaniShyAma shAtravAn
shlokas.10:
tava hyastrANi divyAni mama chaiva na sa.nshayaH |
sAtvato.api maheShvAso nityaM yuddheShu kovidaH
shlokas.11:
te vayaM sahitAstAta sarvA~nshatrUnsamAgatAn |
prasahya samare hatvA prItiM prApsyAma puShkalAm
vishramasva tvamavyagraH svapa chemAM nishAM sukham
shlokas.12:
ahaM cha kRRitavarmA cha prayAntaM tvAM narottama |
anuyAsyAva sahitau dhanvinau paratApinau
rathinaM tvarayA yAntaM rathAvAsthAya da.nshitau
shlokas.13:
sa gatvA shibiraM teShAM nAma vishrAvya chAhave |
tataH kartAsi shatrUNAM yudhyatAM kadanaM mahat
shlokas.14:
kRRitvA cha kadanaM teShAM prabhAte vimale.ahani |
viharasva yathA shakraH sUdayitvA mahAsurAn
shlokas.15:
tvaM hi shakto raNe jetuM pA~nchAlAnAM varUthinIm |
daityasenAmiva kruddhaH sarvadAnavasUdanaH
shlokas.16:
mayA tvAM sahitaM sa~Nkhye guptaM cha kRRitavarmaNA |
na saheta vibhuH sAkShAdvajrapANirapi svayam
shlokas.17:
na chAhaM samare tAta kRRitavarmA tathaiva cha |
anirjitya raNe pANDUnvyapayAsyAva karhichit
shlokas.18:
hatvA cha samare kShudrAnpA~nchAlAnpANDubhiH saha |
nivartiShyAmahe sarve hatA vA svargagA vayam
shlokas.19:
sarvopAyaiH sahAyAste prabhAte vayameva hi |
satyametanmahAbAho prabravImi tavAnagha
shlokas.20:
evamuktastato drauNirmAtulena hitaM vachaH |
abravInmAtulaM rAjankrodhAdudvRRitya lochane
shlokas.21:
Aturasya kuto nidrA narasyAmarShitasya cha |
arthA.nshchintayatashchApi kAmayAnasya vA punaH
shlokas.22:
tadidaM samanuprAptaM pashya me.adya chatuShTayam |
yasya bhAgashchaturtho me svapnamahnAya nAshayet
shlokas.23:
kiM nAma duHkhaM loke.asminpiturvadhamanusmaran |
hRRidayaM nirdahanme.adya rAtryahAni na shAmyati
shlokas.24:
yathA cha nihataH pApaiH pitA mama visheShataH |
pratyakShamapi te sarvaM tanme marmANi kRRintati
shlokas.25:
kathaM hi mAdRRisho loke muhUrtamapi jIvati |
droNo hateti yadvAchaH pA~nchAlAnAM shRRiNomyaham
shlokas.26:
dRRiShTadyumnamahatvAjau nAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
sa me pitRRivadhAdvadhyaH pA~nchAlA ye cha sa~NgatAH
shlokas.27:
vilApo bhagnasakthasya yastu rAj~no mayA shrutaH |
sa punarhRRidayaM kasya krUrasyApi na nirdahet
shlokas.28:
kasya hyakaruNasyApi netrAbhyAmashru nAvrajet |
nRRipaterbhagnasakthasya shrutvA tAdRRigvachaH punaH
shlokas.29:
yashchAyaM mitrapakSho me mayi jIvati nirjitaH |
shokaM me vardhayatyeSha vArivega ivArNavam
ekAgramanaso me.adya kuto nidrA kutaH sukham
shlokas.30:
vAsudevArjunAbhyAM hi tAnahaM parirakShitAn |
aviShahyatamAnmanye mahendreNApi mAtula
shlokas.31:
na chAsmi shakyaH sa.nyantumasmAtkAryAtkatha~nchana |
na taM pashyAmi loke.asminyo mAM kAryAnnivartayet
iti me nishchitA buddhireShA sAdhumatA cha me
shlokas.32:
vArttikaiH kathyamAnastu mitrANAM me parAbhavaH |
pANDavAnAM cha vijayo hRRidayaM dahatIva me
shlokas.33:
ahaM tu kadanaM kRRitvA shatrUNAmadya sauptike |
tato vishramitA chaiva svaptA cha vigatajvaraH

shlokas.1:
kRRipa uvAcha||
shushrUShurapi durmedhAH puruSho.aniyatendriyaH |
nAlaM vedayituM kRRitsnau dharmArthAviti me matiH
shlokas.2:
tathaiva tAvanmedhAvI vinayaM yo na shikShati |
na cha ki~nchana jAnAti so.api dharmArthanishchayam
shlokas.3:
shushrUShustveva medhAvI puruSho niyatendriyaH |
jAnIyAdAgamAnsarvAngrAhyaM cha na virodhayet
shlokas.4:
aneyastvavamAnI yo durAtmA pApapUruShaH |
diShTamutsRRijya kalyANaM karoti bahupApakam
shlokas.5:
nAthavantaM tu suhRRidaH pratiShedhanti pAtakAt |
nivartate tu lakShmIvAnnAlakShmIvAnnivartate
shlokas.6:
yathA hyuchchAvachairvAkyaiH kShiptachitto niyamyate |
tathaiva suhRRidA shakyo nashakyastvavasIdati
shlokas.7:
tathaiva suhRRidaM prAj~naM kurvANaM karma pApakam |
prAj~nAH sampratiShedhante yathAshakti punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
sa kalyANe matiM kRRitvA niyamyAtmAnamAtmanA |
kuru me vachanaM tAta yena pashchAnna tapyase
shlokas.9:
na vadhaH pUjyate loke suptAnAmiha dharmataH |
tathaiva nyastashastrANAM vimuktarathavAjinAm
shlokas.10:
ye cha brUyustavAsmIti ye cha syuH sharaNAgatAH |
vimuktamUrdhajA ye cha ye chApi hatavAhanAH
shlokas.11:
adya svapsyanti pA~nchAlA vimuktakavachA vibho |
vishvastA rajanIM sarve pretA iva vichetasaH
shlokas.12:
yasteShAM tadavasthAnAM druhyeta puruSho.anRRijuH |
vyaktaM sa narake majjedagAdhe vipule.aplave
shlokas.13:
sarvAstraviduShAM loke shreShThastvamasi vishrutaH |
na cha te jAtu loke.asminsusUkShmamapi kilbiSham
shlokas.14:
tvaM punaH sUryasa~NkAshaH shvobhUta udite ravau |
prakAshe sarvabhUtAnAM vijetA yudhi shAtravAn
shlokas.15:
asambhAvitarUpaM hi tvayi karma vigarhitam |
shukle raktamiva nyastaM bhavediti matirmama
shlokas.16:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
evametadyathAttha tvamanushAsmIha mAtula |
taistu pUrvamayaM setuH shatadhA vidalIkRRitaH
shlokas.17:
pratyakShaM bhUmipAlAnAM bhavatAM chApi saMnidhau |
nyastashastro mama pitA dhRRiShTadyumnena pAtitaH
shlokas.18:
karNashcha patite chakre rathasya rathinAM varaH |
uttame vyasane sanno hato gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.19:
tathA shAntanavo bhIShmo nyastashastro nirAyudhaH |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya hato gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.20:
bhUrishravA maheShvAsastathA prAyagato raNe |
kroshatAM bhUmipAlAnAM yuyudhAnena pAtitaH
shlokas.21:
duryodhanashcha bhImena sametya gadayA mRRidhe |
pashyatAM bhUmipAlAnAmadharmeNa nipAtitaH
shlokas.22:
ekAkI bahubhistatra parivArya mahArathaiH |
adharmeNa naravyAghro bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.23:
vilApo bhagnasakthasya yo me rAj~naH parishrutaH |
vArttikAnAM kathayatAM sa me marmANi kRRintati
shlokas.24:
evamadhArmikAH pApAH pA~nchAlA bhinnasetavaH |
tAnevaM bhinnamaryAdAnkiM bhavAnna vigarhati
shlokas.25:
pitRRihantR^InahaM hatvA pA~nchAlAnnishi sauptike |
kAmaM kITaH pata~Ngo vA janma prApya bhavAmi vai
shlokas.26:
tvare chAhamanenAdya yadidaM me chikIrShitam |
tasya me tvaramANasya kuto nidrA kutaH sukham
shlokas.27:
na sa jAtaH pumA.Nlloke kashchinna cha bhaviShyati |
yo me vyAvartayedetAM vadhe teShAM kRRitAM matim
shlokas.28:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahArAja droNaputraH pratApavAn |
ekAnte yojayitvAshvAnprAyAdabhimukhaH parAn
shlokas.29:
tamabrUtAM mahAtmAnau bhojashAradvatAvubhau |
kimayaM syandano yuktaH kiM cha kAryaM chikIrShitam
shlokas.30:
ekasArthaM prayAtau svastvayA saha nararShabha |
samaduHkhasukhau chaiva nAvAM sha~Nkitumarhasi
shlokas.31:
ashvatthAmA tu sa~NkruddhaH piturvadhamanusmaran |
tAbhyAM tathyaM tadAchakhyau yadasyAtmachikIrShitam
shlokas.32:
hatvA shatasahasrANi yodhAnAM nishitaiH sharaiH |
nyastashastro mama pitA dhRRiShTadyumnena pAtitaH
shlokas.33:
taM tathaiva haniShyAmi nyastavarmANamadya vai |
putraM pA~nchAlarAjasya pApaM pApena karmaNA
shlokas.34:
kathaM cha nihataH pApaH pA~nchAlaH pashuvanmayA |
shastrAhavajitAM lokAnprApnuyAditi me matiH
shlokas.35:
kShipraM saMnaddhakavachau sakhaDgAvAttakArmukau |
samAsthAya pratIkShetAM rathavaryau parantapau
shlokas.36:
ityuktvA rathamAsthAya prAyAdabhimukhaH parAn |
tamanvagAtkRRipo rAjankRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.37:
te prayAtA vyarochanta parAnabhimukhAstrayaH |
hUyamAnA yathA yaj~ne samiddhA havyavAhanAH
shlokas.38:
yayushcha shibiraM teShAM samprasuptajanaM vibho |
dvAradeshaM tu samprApya drauNistasthau rathottame

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dvAradeshe tato drauNimavasthitamavekShya tau |
akurvatAM bhojakRRipau kiM sa~njaya vadasva me
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kRRitavarmANamAmantrya kRRipaM cha sa mahAratham |
drauNirmanyuparItAtmA shibiradvAramAsadat
shlokas.3:
tatra bhUtaM mahAkAyaM chandrArkasadRRishadyutim |
so.apashyaddvAramAvRRitya tiShThantaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.4:
vasAnaM charma vaiyAghraM mahArudhiravisravam |
kRRiShNAjinottarAsa~NgaM nAgayaj~nopavItinam
shlokas.6:
daMShTrAkarAlavadanaM vyAditAsyaM bhayAvaham |
nayanAnAM sahasraishcha vichitrairabhibhUShitam
shlokas.7:
naiva tasya vapuH shakyaM pravaktuM veSha eva vA |
sarvathA tu tadAlakShya sphuTeyurapi parvatAH
shlokas.8:
tasyAsyAnnAsikAbhyAM cha shravaNAbhyAM cha sarvashaH |
tebhyashchAkShisahasrebhyaH prAdurAsanmahArchiShaH
shlokas.9:
tathA tejomarIchibhyaH sha~NkhachakragadAdharAH |
prAdurAsanhRRiShIkeshAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.11:
drauNimuktA~nsharA.nstA.nstu tadbhUtaM mahadagrasat |
udadheriva vAryoghAnpAvako vaDavAmukhaH
shlokas.12:
ashvatthAmA tu samprekShya tA~nsharaughAnnirarthakAn |
rathashaktiM mumochAsmai dIptAmagnishikhAmiva
shlokas.13:
sA tadAhatya dIptAgrA rathashaktirashIryata |
yugAnte sUryamAhatya maholkeva divashchyutA
shlokas.14:
atha hematsaruM divyaM khaDgamAkAshavarchasam |
koshAtsamudbabarhAshu bilAddIptamivoragam
shlokas.15:
tataH khaDgavaraM dhImAnbhUtAya prAhiNottadA |
sa tadAsAdya bhUtaM vai vilayaM tUlavadyayau
shlokas.16:
tataH sa kupito drauNirindraketunibhAM gadAm |
jvalantIM prAhiNottasmai bhUtaM tAmapi chAgrasat
shlokas.18:
tadadbhutatamaM dRRiShTvA droNaputro nirAyudhaH |
abravIdabhisantaptaH kRRipavAkyamanusmaran
shlokas.19:
bruvatAmapriyaM pathyaM suhRRidAM na shRRiNoti yaH |
sa shochatyApadaM prApya yathAhamativartya tau
shlokas.20:
shAstradRRiShTAnavadhyAnyaH samatItya jighA.nsati |
sa pathaH prachyuto dharmyAtkupathaM pratipadyate
shlokas.22:
mattonmattapramatteShu na shastrANyupadhArayet |
ityevaM gurubhiH pUrvamupadiShTaM nRRiNAM sadA
shlokas.23:
so.ahamutkramya panthAnaM shAstradRRiShTaM sanAtanam |
amArgeNaivamArabhya ghorAmApadamAgataH
shlokas.24:
tAM chApadaM ghoratarAM pravadanti manIShiNaH |
yadudyamya mahatkRRityaM bhayAdapi nivartate
shlokas.25:
ashakyaM chaiva kaH kartuM shaktaH shaktibalAdiha |
na hi daivAdgarIyo vai mAnuShaM karma kathyate
shlokas.26:
mAnuShaM kurvataH karma yadi daivAnna sidhyati |
sa pathaH prachyuto dharmyAdvipadaM pratipadyate
shlokas.27:
pratighAtaM hyavij~nAtaM pravadanti manIShiNaH |
yadArabhya kriyAM kA~nchidbhayAdiha nivartate
shlokas.28:
tadidaM duShpraNItena bhayaM mAM samupasthitam |
na hi droNasutaH sa~Nkhye nivarteta katha~nchana
shlokas.29:
idaM cha sumahadbhUtaM daivadaNDamivodyatam |
na chaitadabhijAnAmi chintayannapi sarvathA
shlokas.30:
dhruvaM yeyamadharme me pravRRittA kaluShA matiH |
tasyAH phalamidaM ghoraM pratighAtAya dRRishyate
shlokas.31:
tadidaM daivavihitaM mama sa~Nkhye nivartanam |
nAnyatra daivAdudyantumiha shakyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.32:
so.ahamadya mahAdevaM prapadye sharaNaM prabhum |
daivadaNDamimaM ghoraM sa hi me nAshayiShyati
shlokas.33:
kapardinaM prapadyAtha devadevamumApatim |
kapAlamAlinaM rudraM bhaganetraharaM haram
shlokas.34:
sa hi devo.atyagAddevA.nstapasA vikrameNa cha |
tasmAchCharaNamabhyeShye girishaM shUlapANinam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa evaM chintayitvA tu droNaputro vishAM pate |
avatIrya rathopasthAddadhyau samprayataH sthitaH
shlokas.2:
drauNiruvAcha||
ugraM sthANuM shivaM rudraM sharvamIshAnamIshvaram |
girishaM varadaM devaM bhavaM bhAvanamavyayam
shlokas.3:
shitikaNThamajaM shakraM krathaM kratuharaM haram |
vishvarUpaM virUpAkShaM bahurUpamumApatim
shlokas.4:
shmashAnavAsinaM dRRiptaM mahAgaNapatiM prabhum |
khaTvA~NgadhAriNaM muNDaM jaTilaM brahmachAriNam
shlokas.6:
stutaM stutyaM stUyamAnamamoghaM charmavAsasam |
vilohitaM nIlakaNThamapRRiktaM durnivAraNam
shlokas.7:
shukraM vishvasRRijaM brahma brahmachAriNameva cha |
vratavantaM taponityamanantaM tapatAM gatim
shlokas.8:
bahurUpaM gaNAdhyakShaM tryakShaM pAriShadapriyam |
gaNAdhyakShekShitamukhaM gaurIhRRidayavallabham
shlokas.10:
paraM parebhyaH paramaM paraM yasmAnna vidyate |
iShvastrottamabhartAraM digantaM chaiva dakShiNam
shlokas.11:
hiraNyakavachaM devaM chandramaulivibhUShitam |
prapadye sharaNaM devaM parameNa samAdhinA
shlokas.12:
imAM chApyApadaM ghorAM tarAmyadya sudustarAm |
sarvabhUtopahAreNa yakShye.ahaM shuchinA shuchim
shlokas.13:
iti tasya vyavasitaM j~nAtvA tyAgAtmakaM manaH |
purastAtkA~nchanI vediH prAdurAsInmahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
tasyAM vedyAM tadA rAja.nshchitrabhAnurajAyata |
dyAM disho vidishaH khaM cha jvAlAbhirabhipUrayan
shlokas.17:
kAkavaktrAH plavamukhAH shukavaktrAstathaiva cha |
mahAjagaravaktrAshcha ha.nsavaktrAH sitaprabhAH
shlokas.19:
mahAmakaravaktrAshcha timivaktrAstathaiva cha |
harivaktrAH krau~nchamukhAH kapotebhamukhAstathA
shlokas.20:
pArAvatamukhAshchaiva madguvaktrAstathaiva cha |
pANikarNAH sahasrAkShAstathaiva cha shatodarAH
shlokas.21:
nirmA.nsAH kokavaktrAshcha shyenavaktrAshcha bhArata |
tathaivAshiraso rAjannRRikShavaktrAshcha bhIShaNAH
shlokas.22:
pradIptanetrajihvAshcha jvAlAvaktrAstathaiva cha |
meShavaktrAstathaivAnye tathA ChAgamukhA nRRipa
shlokas.23:
sha~NkhAbhAH sha~NkhavaktrAshcha sha~NkhakarNAstathaiva cha |
sha~NkhamAlAparikarAH sha~NkhadhvanisamasvanAH
shlokas.24:
jaTAdharAH pa~nchashikhAstathA muNDAH kRRishodarAH |
chaturdaMShTrAshchaturjihvAH sha~NkukarNAH kirITinaH
shlokas.25:
maulIdharAshcha rAjendra tathAku~nchitamUrdhajAH |
uShNIShiNo mukuTinashchAruvaktrAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.26:
padmotpalApIDadharAstathA kumudadhAriNaH |
mAhAtmyena cha sa.nyuktAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.27:
shataghnIchakrahastAshcha tathA musalapANayaH |
bhushuNDIpAshahastAshcha gadAhastAshcha bhArata
shlokas.28:
pRRiShTheShu baddheShudhayashchitrabANA raNotkaTAH |
sadhvajAH sapatAkAshcha saghaNTAH saparashvadhAH
shlokas.30:
rajodhvastAH pa~NkadigdhAH sarve shuklAmbarasrajaH |
nIlA~NgAH kamalA~NgAshcha muNDavaktrAstathaiva cha
shlokas.32:
gAyamAnAstathaivAnye nRRityamAnAstathApare |
la~NghayantaH plavantashcha valgantashcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.33:
dhAvanto javanAshchaNDAH pavanoddhUtamUrdhajAH |
mattA iva mahAnAgA vinadanto muhurmuhuH
shlokas.35:
ratnachitrA~NgadadharAH samudyatakarAstathA |
hantAro dviShatAM shUrAH prasahyAsahyavikramAH
shlokas.36:
pAtAro.asRRigvasAdyAnAM mA.nsAntrakRRitabhojanAH |
chUDAlAH karNikAlAshcha prakRRishAH piTharodarAH
shlokas.38:
mahArhanAnAmukuTA muNDAshcha jaTilAH pare |
sArkendugrahanakShatrAM dyAM kuryurye mahItale
shlokas.39:
utsahera.nshcha ye hantuM bhUtagrAmaM chaturvidham |
ye cha vItabhayA nityaM harasya bhrukuTIbhaTAH
shlokas.41:
prApyAShTaguNamaishvaryaM ye na yAnti cha vismayam |
yeShAM vismayate nityaM bhagavAnkarmabhirharaH
shlokas.43:
pibanto.asRRigvasAstvanye kruddhA brahmadviShAM sadA |
chaturvi.nshAtmakaM somaM ye pibanti cha nityadA
shlokas.44:
shrutena brahmacharyeNa tapasA cha damena cha |
ye samArAdhya shUlA~NkaM bhavasAyujyamAgatAH
shlokas.45:
yairAtmabhUtairbhagavAnpArvatyA cha maheshvaraH |
saha bhUtagaNAnbhu~Nkte bhUtabhavyabhavatprabhuH
shlokas.47:
sa.nstuvanto mahAdevaM bhAH kurvANAH suvarchasaH |
vivardhayiShavo drauNermahimAnaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.48:
jij~nAsamAnAstattejaH sauptikaM cha didRRikShavaH |
bhImograparighAlAtashUlapaTTishapANayaH
ghorarUpAH samAjagmurbhUtasa~NghAH samantataH
shlokas.49:
janayeyurbhayaM ye sma trailokyasyApi darshanAt |
tAnprekShamANo.api vyathAM na chakAra mahAbalaH
shlokas.51:
dhanUMShi samidhastatra pavitrANi shitAH sharAH |
havirAtmavatashchAtmA tasminbhArata karmaNi
shlokas.52:
tataH saumyena mantreNa droNaputraH pratApavAn |
upahAraM mahAmanyurathAtmAnamupAharat
shlokas.53:
taM rudraM raudrakarmANaM raudraiH karmabhirachyutam |
abhiShTutya mahAtmAnamityuvAcha kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.54:
imamAtmAnamadyAhaM jAtamA~Ngirase kule |
agnau juhomi bhagavanpratigRRihNIShva mAM balim
shlokas.55:
bhavadbhaktyA mahAdeva parameNa samAdhinA |
asyAmApadi vishvAtmannupAkurmi tavAgrataH
shlokas.56:
tvayi sarvANi bhUtAni sarvabhUteShu chAsi vai |
guNAnAM hi pradhAnAnAmekatvaM tvayi tiShThati
shlokas.57:
sarvabhUtAshaya vibho havirbhUtamupasthitam |
pratigRRihANa mAM deva yadyashakyAH pare mayA
shlokas.58:
ityuktvA drauNirAsthAya tAM vedIM dIptapAvakAm |
santyaktAtmA samAruhya kRRiShNavartmanyupAvishat
shlokas.59:
tamUrdhvabAhuM nishcheShTaM dRRiShTvA havirupasthitam |
abravIdbhagavAnsAkShAnmahAdevo hasanniva
shlokas.60:
satyashauchArjavatyAgaistapasA niyamena cha |
kShAntyA bhaktyA cha dhRRityA cha buddhyA cha vachasA tathA
shlokas.61:
yathAvadahamArAddhaH kRRiShNenAkliShTakarmaNA |
tasmAdiShTatamaH kRRiShNAdanyo mama na vidyate
shlokas.62:
kurvatA tasya saMmAnaM tvAM cha jij~nAsatA mayA |
pA~nchAlAH sahasA guptA mAyAshcha bahushaH kRRitAH
shlokas.63:
kRRitastasyaiSha saMmAnaH pA~nchAlAnrakShatA mayA |
abhibhUtAstu kAlena naiShAmadyAsti jIvitam
shlokas.64:
evamuktvA maheShvAsaM bhagavAnAtmanastanum |
Avivesha dadau chAsmai vimalaM khaDgamuttamam
shlokas.65:
athAviShTo bhagavatA bhUyo jajvAla tejasA |
varShmavA.nshchAbhavadyuddhe devasRRiShTena tejasA
shlokas.66:
tamadRRishyAni bhUtAni rakShA.nsi cha samAdravan |
abhitaH shatrushibiraM yAntaM sAkShAdiveshvaram

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA prayAte shibiraM droNaputre mahArathe |
kachchitkRRipashcha bhojashcha bhayArtau na nyavartatAm
shlokas.2:
kachchinna vAritau kShudrai rakShibhirnopalakShitau |
asahyamiti vA matvA na nivRRittau mahArathau
shlokas.3:
kachchitpramathya shibiraM hatvA somakapANDavAn |
duryodhanasya padavIM gatau paramikAM raNe
shlokas.4:
pA~nchAlairvA vinihatau kachchinnAsvapatAM kShitau |
kachchittAbhyAM kRRitaM karma tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminprayAte shibiraM droNaputre mahAtmani |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha shibiradvAryatiShThatAm
shlokas.6:
ashvatthAmA tu tau dRRiShTvA yatnavantau mahArathau |
prahRRiShTaH shanakai rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
yattau bhavantau paryAptau sarvakShatrasya nAshane |
kiM punaryodhasheShasya prasuptasya visheShataH
shlokas.8:
ahaM pravekShye shibiraM chariShyAmi cha kAlavat |
yathA na kashchidapi me jIvanmuchyeta mAnavaH
shlokas.9:
ityuktvA prAvishaddrauNiH pArthAnAM shibiraM mahat |
advAreNAbhyavaskandya vihAya bhayamAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
sa pravishya mahAbAhuruddeshaj~nashcha tasya ha |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya nilayaM shanakairabhyupAgamat
shlokas.11:
te tu kRRitvA mahatkarma shrAntAshcha balavadraNe |
prasuptA vai suvishvastAH svasainyaparivAritAH
shlokas.12:
atha pravishya tadveshma dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhArata |
pA~nchAlyaM shayane drauNirapashyatsuptamantikAt
shlokas.13:
kShaumAvadAte mahati spardhyAstaraNasa.nvRRite |
mAlyapravarasa.nyukte dhUpaishchUrNaishcha vAsite
shlokas.14:
taM shayAnaM mahAtmAnaM visrabdhamakutobhayam |
prAbodhayata pAdena shayanasthaM mahIpate
shlokas.15:
sa buddhvA charaNasparshamutthAya raNadurmadaH |
abhyajAnadameyAtmA droNaputraM mahAratham
shlokas.16:
tamutpatantaM shayanAdashvatthAmA mahAbalaH |
kesheShvAlambya pANibhyAM niShpipeSha mahItale
shlokas.17:
sa balAttena niShpiShTaH sAdhvasena cha bhArata |
nidrayA chaiva pA~nchAlyo nAshakachcheShTituM tadA
shlokas.18:
tamAkramya tadA rAjankaNThe chorasi chobhayoH |
nadantaM visphurantaM cha pashumAramamArayat
shlokas.19:
tudannakhaistu sa drauNiM nAtivyaktamudAharat |
AchAryaputra shastreNa jahi mA mA chiraM kRRithAH
tvatkRRite sukRRitA.NllokAngachCheyaM dvipadAM vara
shlokas.20:
tasyAvyaktAM tu tAM vAchaM sa.nshrutya drauNirabravIt |
AchAryaghAtinAM lokA na santi kulapA.nsana
tasmAchChastreNa nidhanaM na tvamarhasi durmate
shlokas.21:
evaM bruvANastaM vIraM siMho mattamiva dvipam |
marmasvabhyavadhItkruddhaH pAdAShThIlaiH sudAruNaiH
shlokas.22:
tasya vIrasya shabdena mAryamANasya veshmani |
abudhyanta mahArAja striyo ye chAsya rakShiNaH
shlokas.23:
te dRRiShTvA varShmavantaM tamatimAnuShavikramam |
bhUtameva vyavasyanto na sma pravyAharanbhayAt
shlokas.24:
taM tu tenAbhyupAyena gamayitvA yamakShayam |
adhyatiShThatsa tejasvI rathaM prApya sudarshanam
shlokas.25:
sa tasya bhavanAdrAjanniShkramyAnAdayandishaH |
rathena shibiraM prAyAjjighA.nsurdviShato balI
shlokas.26:
apakrAnte tatastasmindroNaputre mahArathe |
saha tai rakShibhiH sarvaiH praNeduryoShitastadA
shlokas.27:
rAjAnaM nihataM dRRiShTvA bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH |
vyAkroshankShatriyAH sarve dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhArata
shlokas.28:
tAsAM tu tena shabdena samIpe kShatriyarShabhAH |
kShipraM cha samanahyanta kimetaditi chAbruvan
shlokas.29:
striyastu rAjanvitrastA bhAradvAjaM nirIkShya tam |
abruvandInakaNThena kShipramAdravateti vai
shlokas.30:
rAkShaso vA manuShyo vA nainaM jAnImahe vayam |
hatvA pA~nchAlarAjaM yo rathamAruhya tiShThati
shlokas.31:
tataste yodhamukhyAstaM sahasA paryavArayan |
sa tAnApatataH sarvAnrudrAstreNa vyapothayat
shlokas.32:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha hatvA sa tA.nshchaivAsya padAnugAn |
apashyachChayane suptamuttamaujasamantike
shlokas.33:
tamapyAkramya pAdena kaNThe chorasi chaujasA |
tathaiva mArayAmAsa vinardantamari.ndamam
shlokas.34:
yudhAmanyustu samprApto mattvA taM rakShasA hatam |
gadAmudyamya vegena hRRidi drauNimatADayat
shlokas.35:
tamabhidrutya jagrAha kShitau chainamapAtayat |
visphurantaM cha pashuvattathaivainamamArayat
shlokas.36:
tathA sa vIro hatvA taM tato.anyAnsamupAdravat |
sa.nsuptAneva rAjendra tatra tatra mahArathAn
sphurato vepamAnA.nshcha shamiteva pashUnmakhe
shlokas.38:
tathaiva gulme samprekShya shayAnAnmadhyagaulmikAn |
shrAntAnnyastAyudhAnsarvAnkShaNenaiva vyapothayat
shlokas.39:
yodhAnashvAndvipA.nshchaiva prAchChinatsa varAsinA |
rudhirokShitasarvA~NgaH kAlasRRiShTa ivAntakaH
shlokas.40:
visphuradbhishcha tairdrauNirnistri.nshasyodyamena cha |
AkShepeNa tathaivAsestridhA raktokShito.abhavat
shlokas.41:
tasya lohitasiktasya dIptakhaDgasya yudhyataH |
amAnuSha ivAkAro babhau paramabhIShaNaH
shlokas.42:
ye tvajAgrata kauravya te.api shabdena mohitAH |
nirIkShyamANA anyonyaM drauNiM dRRiShTvA pravivyathuH
shlokas.43:
tadrUpaM tasya te dRRiShTvA kShatriyAH shatrukarshanAH |
rAkShasaM manyamAnAstaM nayanAni nyamIlayan
shlokas.44:
sa ghorarUpo vyacharatkAlavachChibire tataH |
apashyaddraupadIputrAnavashiShTA.nshcha somakAn
shlokas.45:
tena shabdena vitrastA dhanurhastA mahArathAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM hataM shrutvA draupadeyA vishAM pate
avAkira~nsharavrAtairbhAradvAjamabhItavat
shlokas.46:
tatastena ninAdena samprabuddhAH prabhadrakAH |
shilImukhaiH shikhaNDI cha droNaputraM samArdayan
shlokas.47:
bhAradvAjastu tAndRRiShTvA sharavarShANi varShataH |
nanAda balavannAdaM jighA.nsustAnsudurjayAn
shlokas.49:
sahasrachandraM vipulaM gRRihItvA charma sa.nyuge |
khaDgaM cha vipulaM divyaM jAtarUpapariShkRRitam
draupadeyAnabhidrutya khaDgena vyacharadbalI
shlokas.50:
tataH sa narashArdUlaH prativindhyaM tamAhave |
kukShideshe.avadhIdrAjansa hato nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.51:
prAsena viddhvA drauNiM tu sutasomaH pratApavAn |
punashchAsiM samudyamya droNaputramupAdravat
shlokas.52:
sutasomasya sAsiM tu bAhuM ChittvA nararShabhaH |
punarabhyahanatpArshve sa bhinnahRRidayo.apatat
shlokas.53:
nAkulistu shatAnIko rathachakreNa vIryavAn |
dorbhyAmutkShipya vegena vakShasyenamatADayat
shlokas.54:
atADayachChatAnIkaM muktachakraM dvijastu saH |
sa vihvalo yayau bhUmiM tato.asyApAharachChiraH
shlokas.55:
shrutakarmA tu parighaM gRRihItvA samatADayat |
abhidrutya tato drauNiM savye sa phalake bhRRisham
shlokas.56:
sa tu taM shrutakarmANamAsye jaghne varAsinA |
sa hato nyapatadbhUmau vimUDho vikRRitAnanaH
shlokas.57:
tena shabdena vIrastu shrutakIrtirmahAdhanuH |
ashvatthAmAnamAsAdya sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.58:
tasyApi sharavarShANi charmaNA prativArya saH |
sakuNDalaM shiraH kAyAdbhrAjamAnamapAharat
shlokas.59:
tato bhIShmanihantA taM saha sarvaiH prabhadrakaiH |
ahanatsarvato vIraM nAnApraharaNairbalI
shilImukhena chApyenaM bhruvormadhye samArdayat
shlokas.60:
sa tu krodhasamAviShTo droNaputro mahAbalaH |
shikhaNDinaM samAsAdya dvidhA chichCheda so.asinA
shlokas.61:
shikhaNDinaM tato hatvA krodhAviShTaH parantapaH |
prabhadrakagaNAnsarvAnabhidudrAva vegavAn
yachcha shiShTaM virATasya balaM tachcha samAdravat
shlokas.62:
drupadasya cha putrANAM pautrANAM suhRRidAmapi |
chakAra kadanaM ghoraM dRRiShTvA dRRiShTvA mahAbalaH
shlokas.64:
kAlIM raktAsyanayanAM raktamAlyAnulepanAm |
raktAmbaradharAmekAM pAshahastAM shikhaNDinIm
shlokas.65:
dadRRishuH kAlarAtriM te smayamAnAmavasthitAm |
narAshvaku~njarAnpAshairbaddhvA ghoraiH pratasthuShIm
harantIM vividhAnpretAnpAshabaddhAnvimUrdhajAn
shlokas.66:
svapne suptAnnayantIM tAM rAtriShvanyAsu mAriSha |
dadRRishuryodhamukhyAste ghnantaM drauNiM cha nityadA
shlokas.67:
yataH pravRRittaH sa~NgrAmaH kurupANDavasenayoH |
tataH prabhRRiti tAM kRRityAmapashyandrauNimeva cha
shlokas.69:
tadanusmRRitya te vIrA darshanaM paurvakAlikam |
idaM tadityamanyanta daivenopanipIDitAH
shlokas.70:
tatastena ninAdena pratyabudhyanta dhanvinaH |
shibire pANDaveyAnAM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.71:
so.achChinatkasyachitpAdau jaghanaM chaiva kasyachit |
kA.nshchidbibheda pArshveShu kAlasRRiShTa ivAntakaH
shlokas.73:
kroshatAM kimidaM ko.ayaM kiM shabdaH kiM nu kiM kRRitam |
evaM teShAM tadA drauNirantakaH samapadyata
shlokas.75:
tatastachChastravitrastA utpatanto bhayAturAH |
nidrAndhA naShTasa~nj~nAshcha tatra tatra nililyire
shlokas.76:
UrustambhagRRihItAshcha kashmalAbhihataujasaH |
vinadanto bhRRishaM trastAH saMnyapeShanparasparam
shlokas.77:
tato rathaM punardrauNirAsthito bhImanisvanam |
dhanuShpANiH sharairanyAnpreShayadvai yamakShayam
shlokas.79:
tathaiva syandanAgreNa pramathansa vidhAvati |
sharavarShaishcha vividhairavarShachChAtravA.nstataH
shlokas.80:
punashcha suvichitreNa shatachandreNa charmaNA |
tena chAkAshavarNena tadAcharata so.asinA
shlokas.81:
tathA sa shibiraM teShAM drauNirAhavadurmadaH |
vyakShobhayata rAjendra mahAhradamiva dvipaH
shlokas.82:
utpetustena shabdena yodhA rAjanvichetasaH |
nidrArtAshcha bhayArtAshcha vyadhAvanta tatastataH
shlokas.83:
visvaraM chukrushushchAnye bahvabaddhaM tathAvadan |
na cha sma pratipadyante shastrANi vasanAni cha
shlokas.84:
vimuktakeshAshchApyanye nAbhyajAnanparasparam |
utpatantaH pare bhItAH kechittatra tathAbhraman
purIShamasRRijankechitkechinmUtraM prasusruvuH
shlokas.85:
bandhanAni cha rAjendra sa~nChidya turagA dvipAH |
samaM paryapata.nshchAnye kurvanto mahadAkulam
shlokas.86:
tatra kechinnarA bhItA vyalIyanta mahItale |
tathaiva tAnnipatitAnapiMShangajavAjinaH
shlokas.87:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne rakShA.nsi puruSharShabha |
tRRiptAni vyanadannuchchairmudA bharatasattama
shlokas.88:
sa shabdaH prerito rAjanbhUtasa~NghairmudA yutaiH |
apUrayaddishaH sarvA divaM chApi mahAsvanaH
shlokas.89:
teShAmArtasvaraM shrutvA vitrastA gajavAjinaH |
muktAH paryapatanrAjanmRRidnantaH shibire janam
shlokas.90:
taistatra paridhAvadbhishcharaNodIritaM rajaH |
akarochChibire teShAM rajanyAM dviguNaM tamaH
shlokas.91:
tasmi.nstamasi sa~njAte pramUDhAH sarvato janAH |
nAjAnanpitaraH putrAnbhrAtR^InbhrAtara eva cha
shlokas.92:
gajA gajAnatikramya nirmanuShyA hayA hayAn |
atADaya.nstathAbha~nja.nstathAmRRidna.nshcha bhArata
shlokas.93:
te bhagnAH prapatantashcha nighnantashcha parasparam |
nyapAtayanta cha parAnpAtayitvA tathApiShan
shlokas.94:
vichetasaH sanidrAshcha tamasA chAvRRitA narAH |
jaghnuH svAneva tatrAtha kAlenAbhiprachoditAH
shlokas.95:
tyaktvA dvArANi cha dvAHsthAstathA gulmA.nshcha gaulmikAH |
prAdravanta yathAshakti kA.ndishIkA vichetasaH
shlokas.96:
vipranaShTAshcha te.anyonyaM nAjAnanta tadA vibho |
kroshantastAta putreti daivopahatachetasaH
shlokas.97:
palAyatAM dishasteShAM svAnapyutsRRijya bAndhavAn |
gotranAmabhiranyonyamAkrandanta tato janAH
shlokas.98:
hAhAkAraM cha kurvANAH pRRithivyAM sherate pare |
tAnbuddhvA raNamatto.asau droNaputro vyapothayat
shlokas.99:
tatrApare vadhyamAnA muhurmuhurachetasaH |
shibirAnniShpatanti sma kShatriyA bhayapIDitAH
shlokas.100:
tA.nstu niShpatatastrastA~nshibirA~njIvitaiShiNaH |
kRRitavarmA kRRipashchaiva dvAradeshe nijaghnatuH
shlokas.102:
nAmuchyata tayoH kashchinniShkrAntaH shibirAdbahiH |
kRRipasya cha mahArAja hArdikyasya cha durmateH
shlokas.103:
bhUyashchaiva chikIrShantau droNaputrasya tau priyam |
triShu desheShu dadatuH shibirasya hutAshanam
shlokas.104:
tataH prakAshe shibire khaDgena pitRRinandanaH |
ashvatthAmA mahArAja vyacharatkRRitahastavat
shlokas.105:
kA.nshchidApatato vIrAnaparA.nshcha pradhAvataH |
vyayojayata khaDgena prANairdvijavaro narAn
shlokas.106:
kA.nshchidyodhAnsa khaDgena madhye sa~nChidya vIryavAn |
apAtayaddroNasutaH sa.nrabdhastilakANDavat
shlokas.108:
mAnuShANAM sahasreShu hateShu patiteShu cha |
udatiShThankabandhAni bahUnyutthAya chApatan
shlokas.112:
evaM vicharatastasya nighnataH subahUnnarAn |
tamasA rajanI ghorA babhau dAruNadarshanA
shlokas.113:
ki~nchitprANaishcha puruShairhataishchAnyaiH sahasrashaH |
bahunA cha gajAshvena bhUrabhUdbhImadarshanA
shlokas.114:
yakSharakShaHsamAkIrNe rathAshvadvipadAruNe |
kruddhena droNaputreNa sa~nChinnAH prApatanbhuvi
shlokas.115:
mAtR^Iranye pitR^Inanye bhrAtR^Inanye vichukrushuH |
kechidUchurna tatkruddhairdhArtarAShTraiH kRRitaM raNe
shlokas.116:
yatkRRitaM naH prasuptAnAM rakShobhiH krUrakarmabhiH |
asAMnidhyAddhi pArthAnAmidaM naH kadanaM kRRitam
shlokas.117:
na devAsuragandharvairna yakShairna cha rAkShasaiH |
shakyo vijetuM kaunteyo goptA yasya janArdanaH
shlokas.118:
brahmaNyaH satyavAgdAntaH sarvabhUtAnukampakaH |
na cha suptaM pramattaM vA nyastashastraM kRRitA~njalim
dhAvantaM muktakeshaM vA hanti pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.119:
tadidaM naH kRRitaM ghoraM rakShobhiH krUrakarmabhiH |
iti lAlapyamAnAH sma sherate bahavo janAH
shlokas.120:
stanatAM cha manuShyANAmapareShAM cha kUjatAm |
tato muhUrtAtprAshAmyatsa shabdastumulo mahAn
shlokas.121:
shoNitavyatiShiktAyAM vasudhAyAM cha bhUmipa |
tadrajastumulaM ghoraM kShaNenAntaradhIyata
shlokas.124:
dahyamAnA hutAshena vadhyamAnAshcha tena te |
parasparaM tadA yodhA anayanyamasAdanam
shlokas.125:
tasyA rajanyAstvardhena pANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
gamayAmAsa rAjendra drauNiryamaniveshanam
shlokas.126:
nishAcharANAM sattvAnAM sa rAtrirharShavardhinI |
AsInnaragajAshvAnAM raudrI kShayakarI bhRRisham
shlokas.127:
tatrAdRRishyanta rakShA.nsi pishAchAshcha pRRithagvidhAH |
khAdanto naramA.nsAni pibantaH shoNitAni cha
shlokas.128:
karAlAH pi~NgalA raudrAH shailadantA rajasvalAH |
jaTilA dIrghasakthAshcha pa~nchapAdA mahodarAH
shlokas.129:
pashchAda~Ngulayo rUkShA virUpA bhairavasvanAH |
ghaTajAnavo.atihrasvAshcha nIlakaNThA vibhIShaNAH
shlokas.130:
saputradArAH sukrUrA durdarshanasunirghRRiNAH |
vividhAni cha rUpANi tatrAdRRishyanta rakShasAm
shlokas.131:
pItvA cha shoNitaM hRRiShTAH prAnRRityangaNasho.apare |
idaM varamidaM medhyamidaM svAdviti chAbruvan
shlokas.132:
medomajjAsthiraktAnAM vasAnAM cha bhRRishAsitAH |
paramA.nsAni khAdantaH kravyAdA mA.nsajIvinaH
shlokas.133:
vasAM chApyapare pItvA paryadhAvanvikukShilAH |
nAnAvaktrAstathA raudrAH kravyAdAH pishitAshinaH
shlokas.134:
ayutAni cha tatrAsanprayutAnyarbudAni cha |
rakShasAM ghorarUpANAM mahatAM krUrakarmaNAm
shlokas.135:
muditAnAM vitRRiptAnAM tasminmahati vaishase |
sametAni bahUnyAsanbhUtAni cha janAdhipa
shlokas.136:
pratyUShakAle shibirAtpratigantumiyeSha saH |
nRRishoNitAvasiktasya drauNerAsIdasitsaruH
pANinA saha sa.nshliShTa ekIbhUta iva prabho
shlokas.137:
sa niHsheShAnarInkRRitvA virarAja janakShaye |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni bhasma kRRitveva pAvakaH
shlokas.138:
yathApratij~naM tatkarma kRRitvA drauNAyaniH prabho |
durgamAM padavIM kRRitvA piturAsIdgatajvaraH
shlokas.139:
yathaiva sa.nsuptajane shibire prAvishannishi |
tathaiva hatvA niHshabde nishchakrAma nararShabhaH
shlokas.140:
niShkramya shibirAttasmAttAbhyAM sa~Ngamya vIryavAn |
Achakhyau karma tatsarvaM hRRiShTaH saMharShayanvibho
shlokas.141:
tAvapyAchakhyatustasmai priyaM priyakarau tadA |
pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayA.nshchaiva vinikRRittAnsahasrashaH
prItyA chochchairudakrosha.nstathaivAsphoTaya.nstalAn
shlokas.142:
eva.nvidhA hi sA rAtriH somakAnAM janakShaye |
prasuptAnAM pramattAnAmAsItsubhRRishadAruNA
shlokas.143:
asa.nshayaM hi kAlasya paryAyo duratikramaH |
tAdRRishA nihatA yatra kRRitvAsmAkaM janakShayam
shlokas.144:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
prAgeva sumahatkarma drauNiretanmahArathaH |
nAkarodIdRRishaM kasmAnmatputravijaye dhRRitaH
shlokas.145:
atha kasmAddhate kShatre karmedaM kRRitavAnasau |
droNaputro maheShvAsastanme sha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.146:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
teShAM nUnaM bhayAnnAsau kRRitavAnkurunandana |
asAMnidhyAddhi pArthAnAM keshavasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.147:
sAtyakeshchApi karmedaM droNaputreNa sAdhitam |
na hi teShAM samakShaM tAnhanyAdapi marutpatiH
shlokas.148:
etadIdRRishakaM vRRittaM rAjansuptajane vibho |
tato janakShayaM kRRitvA pANDavAnAM mahAtyayam
diShTyA diShTyeti chAnyonyaM sametyochurmahArathAH
shlokas.149:
paryaShvajattato drauNistAbhyAM cha pratinanditaH |
idaM harShAchcha sumahadAdade vAkyamuttamam
shlokas.150:
pA~nchAlA nihatAH sarve draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH |
somakA matsyasheShAshcha sarve vinihatA mayA
shlokas.151:
idAnIM kRRitakRRityAH sma yAma tatraiva mAchiram |
yadi jIvati no rAjA tasmai sha.nsAmahe priyam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te hatvA sarvapA~nchAlAndraupadeyA.nshcha sarvashaH |
agachChansahitAstatra yatra duryodhano hataH
shlokas.2:
gatvA chainamapashya.nste ki~nchitprANaM narAdhipam |
tato rathebhyaH praskandya parivavrustavAtmajam
shlokas.3:
taM bhagnasakthaM rAjendra kRRichChraprANamachetasam |
vamantaM rudhiraM vaktrAdapashyanvasudhAtale
shlokas.5:
nivArayantaM kRRichChrAttA~nshvApadAnsa~nchikhAdiShUn |
viveShTamAnaM mahyAM cha subhRRishaM gADhavedanam
shlokas.6:
taM shayAnaM mahAtmAnaM bhUmau svarudhirokShitam |
hatashiShTAstrayo vIrAH shokArtAH paryavArayan
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.7:
taistribhiH shoNitAdigdhairniHshvasadbhirmahArathaiH |
shushubhe sa.nvRRito rAjA vedI tribhirivAgnibhiH
shlokas.8:
te taM shayAnaM samprekShya rAjAnamatathochitam |
aviShahyena duHkhena tataste rurudustrayaH
shlokas.9:
tataste rudhiraM hastairmukhAnnirmRRijya tasya ha |
raNe rAj~naH shayAnasya kRRipaNaM paryadevayan
shlokas.10:
kRRipa uvAcha||
na daivasyAtibhAro.asti yadayaM rudhirokShitaH |
ekAdashachamUbhartA shete duryodhano hataH
shlokas.11:
pashya chAmIkarAbhasya chAmIkaravibhUShitAm |
gadAM gadApriyasyemAM samIpe patitAM bhuvi
shlokas.12:
iyamenaM gadA shUraM na jahAti raNe raNe |
svargAyApi vrajantaM hi na jahAti yashasvinam
shlokas.13:
pashyemAM saha vIreNa jAmbUnadavibhUShitAm |
shayAnAM shayane dharme bhAryAM prItimatImiva
shlokas.14:
yo vai mUrdhAvasiktAnAmagre yAtaH parantapaH |
sa hato grasate pA.nsUnpashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.15:
yenAjau nihatA bhUmAvasherata purA dviShaH |
sa bhUmau nihataH shete kururAjaH parairayam
shlokas.16:
bhayAnnamanti rAjAno yasya sma shatasa~NghashaH |
sa vIrashayane shete kravyAdbhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.17:
upAsata nRRipAH pUrvamarthahetoryamIshvaram |
dhiksadyo nihataH shete pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.18:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM shayAnaM nRRipashreShThaM tato bharatasattama |
ashvatthAmA samAlokya karuNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.19:
AhustvAM rAjashArdUla mukhyaM sarvadhanuShmatAm |
dhanAdhyakShopamaM yuddhe shiShyaM sa~NkarShaNasya ha
shlokas.20:
kathaM vivaramadrAkShIdbhImasenastavAnagha |
balinaH kRRitino nityaM sa cha pApAtmavAnnRRipa
shlokas.21:
kAlo nUnaM mahArAja loke.asminbalavattaraH |
pashyAmo nihataM tvAM chedbhImasenena sa.nyuge
shlokas.22:
kathaM tvAM sarvadharmaj~naM kShudraH pApo vRRikodaraH |
nikRRityA hatavAnmando nUnaM kAlo duratyayaH
shlokas.23:
dharmayuddhe hyadharmeNa samAhUyaujasA mRRidhe |
gadayA bhImasenena nirbhinne sakthinI tava
shlokas.24:
adharmeNa hatasyAjau mRRidyamAnaM padA shiraH |
yadupekShitavAnkShudro dhiktamastu yudhiShThiram
shlokas.25:
yuddheShvapavadiShyanti yodhA nUnaM vRRikodaram |
yAvatsthAsyanti bhUtAni nikRRityA hyasi pAtitaH
shlokas.26:
nanu rAmo.abravIdrAja.nstvAM sadA yadunandanaH |
duryodhanasamo nAsti gadayA iti vIryavAn
shlokas.27:
shlAghate tvAM hi vArShNeyo rAjansa.nsatsu bhArata |
sushiShyo mama kauravyo gadAyuddha iti prabho
shlokas.28:
yAM gatiM kShatriyasyAhuH prashastAM paramarShayaH |
hatasyAbhimukhasyAjau prAptastvamasi tAM gatim
shlokas.29:
duryodhana na shochAmi tvAmahaM puruSharShabha |
hataputrAM tu shochAmi gAndhArIM pitaraM cha te
bhikShukau vichariShyete shochantau pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.30:
dhigastu kRRiShNaM vArShNeyamarjunaM chApi durmatim |
dharmaj~namAninau yau tvAM vadhyamAnamupekShatAm
shlokas.31:
pANDavAshchApi te sarve kiM vakShyanti narAdhipAn |
kathaM duryodhano.asmAbhirhata ityanapatrapAH
shlokas.32:
dhanyastvamasi gAndhAre yastvamAyodhane hataH |
prayAto.abhimukhaH shatrUndharmeNa puruSharShabha
shlokas.33:
hataputrA hi gAndhArI nihataj~nAtibAndhavA |
praj~nAchakShushcha durdharShaH kAM gatiM pratipatsyate
shlokas.34:
dhigastu kRRitavarmANaM mAM kRRipaM cha mahAratham |
ye vayaM na gatAH svargaM tvAM puraskRRitya pArthivam
shlokas.35:
dAtAraM sarvakAmAnAM rakShitAraM prajAhitam |
yadvayaM nAnugachChAmastvAM dhigasmAnnarAdhamAn
shlokas.36:
kRRipasya tava vIryeNa mama chaiva pitushcha me |
sabhRRityAnAM naravyAghra ratnavanti gRRihANi cha
shlokas.37:
bhavatprasAdAdasmAbhiH samitraiH sahabAndhavaiH |
avAptAH kratavo mukhyA bahavo bhUridakShiNAH
shlokas.38:
kutashchApIdRRishaM sArthamupalapsyAmahe vayam |
yAdRRishena puraskRRitya tvaM gataH sarvapArthivAn
shlokas.39:
vayameva trayo rAjangachChantaM paramAM gatim |
yadvai tvAM nAnugachChAmastena tapsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.40:
tvatsvargahInA hInArthAH smarantaH sukRRitasya te |
kiM nAma tadbhavetkarma yena tvAnuvrajema vai
shlokas.41:
duHkhaM nUnaM kurushreShTha chariShyAmo mahImimAm |
hInAnAM nastvayA rAjankutaH shAntiH kutaH sukham
shlokas.42:
gatvaitA.nstu mahArAja sametya tvaM mahArathAn |
yathAshreShThaM yathAjyeShThaM pUjayervachanAnmama
shlokas.43:
AchAryaM pUjayitvA cha ketuM sarvadhanuShmatAm |
hataM mayAdya sha.nsethA dhRRiShTadyumnaM narAdhipa
shlokas.44:
pariShvajethA rAjAnaM bAhlikaM sumahAratham |
saindhavaM somadattaM cha bhUrishravasameva cha
shlokas.46:
ityevamuktvA rAjAnaM bhagnasakthamachetasam |
ashvatthAmA samudvIkShya punarvachanamabravIt
shlokas.47:
duryodhana jIvasi chedvAchaM shrotrasukhAM shRRiNu |
sapta pANDavataH sheShA dhArtarAShTrAstrayo vayam
shlokas.48:
te chaiva bhrAtaraH pa~ncha vAsudevo.atha sAtyakiH |
ahaM cha kRRitavarmA cha kRRipaH shAradvatastathA
shlokas.49:
draupadeyA hatAH sarve dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajAH |
pA~nchAlA nihatAH sarve matsyasheShaM cha bhArata
shlokas.50:
kRRite pratikRRitaM pashya hataputrA hi pANDavAH |
sauptike shibiraM teShAM hataM sanaravAhanam
shlokas.51:
mayA cha pApakarmAsau dhRRiShTadyumno mahIpate |
pravishya shibiraM rAtrau pashumAreNa mAritaH
shlokas.52:
duryodhanastu tAM vAchaM nishamya manasaH priyAm |
pratilabhya punashcheta idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.53:
na me.akarottadgA~Ngeyo na karNo na cha te pitA |
yattvayA kRRipabhojAbhyAM sahitenAdya me kRRitam
shlokas.54:
sa chetsenApatiH kShudro hataH sArdhaM shikhaNDinA |
tena manye maghavatA samamAtmAnamadya vai
shlokas.55:
svasti prApnuta bhadraM vaH svarge naH sa~NgamaH punaH |
ityevamuktvA tUShNIM sa kururAjo mahAmanAH
prANAnudasRRijadvIraH suhRRidAM shokamAdadhat
shlokas.56:
tatheti te pariShvaktAH pariShvajya cha taM nRRipam |
punaH punaH prekShamANAH svakAnAruruhU rathAn
shlokas.57:
ityevaM tava putrasya nishamya karuNAM giram |
pratyUShakAle shokArtaH prAdhAvaM nagaraM prati
shlokas.58:
tava putre gate svargaM shokArtasya mamAnagha |
RRiShidattaM pranaShTaM taddivyadarshitvamadya vai
shlokas.59:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti shrutvA sa nRRipatiH putraj~nAtivadhaM tadA |
niHshvasya dIrghamuShNaM cha tatashchintAparo.abhavat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasyAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAM dhRRiShTadyumnasya sArathiH |
shasha.nsa dharmarAjAya sauptike kadanaM kRRitam
shlokas.2:
draupadeyA mahArAja drupadasyAtmajaiH saha |
pramattA nishi vishvastAH svapantaH shibire svake
shlokas.3:
kRRitavarmaNA nRRisha.nsena gautamena kRRipeNa cha |
ashvatthAmnA cha pApena hataM vaH shibiraM nishi
shlokas.4:
etairnaragajAshvAnAM prAsashaktiparashvadhaiH |
sahasrANi nikRRintadbhirniHsheShaM te balaM kRRitam
shlokas.5:
ChidyamAnasya mahato vanasyeva parashvadhaiH |
shushruve sumahA~nshabdo balasya tava bhArata
shlokas.7:
tachChrutvA vAkyamashivaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
papAta mahyAM durdharShaH putrashokasamanvitaH
shlokas.8:
taM patantamabhikramya parijagrAha sAtyakiH |
bhImaseno.arjunashchaiva mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.9:
labdhachetAstu kaunteyaH shokavihvalayA girA |
jitvA shatrU~njitaH pashchAtparyadevayadAturaH
shlokas.10:
durvidA gatirarthAnAmapi ye divyachakShuShaH |
jIyamAnA jayantyanye jayamAnA vayaM jitAH
shlokas.11:
hatvA bhrAtR^InvayasyA.nshcha pitR^InputrAnsuhRRidgaNAn |
bandhUnamAtyAnpautrA.nshcha jitvA sarvA~njitA vayam
shlokas.13:
yaM jitvA tapyate pashchAdApanna iva durmatiH |
kathaM manyeta vijayaM tato jitataraH paraiH
shlokas.14:
yeShAmarthAya pApasya dhigjayasya suhRRidvadhe |
nirjitairapramattairhi vijitA jitakAshinaH
shlokas.15:
karNinAlIkadaMShTrasya khaDgajihvasya sa.nyuge |
chApavyAttasya raudrasya jyAtalasvananAdinaH
shlokas.16:
kruddhasya narasiMhasya sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH |
ye vyamuchyanta karNasya pramAdAtta ime hatAH
shlokas.17:
rathahradaM sharavarShormimantaM; ratnAchitaM vAhanarAjiyuktam |
shaktyRRiShTimInadhvajanAganakraM; sharAsanAvartamaheShuphenam
shlokas.18:
sa~NgrAmachandrodayavegavelaM; droNArNavaM jyAtalanemighoSham |
ye teruruchchAvachashastranaubhi;ste rAjaputrA nihatAH pramAdAt
shlokas.19:
na hi pramAdAtparamo.asti kashchi;dvadho narANAmiha jIvaloke |
pramattamarthA hi naraM samantA;ttyajantyanarthAshcha samAvishanti
shlokas.21:
mahAchamUkakShavarAbhipannaM; mahAhave bhIShmamahAdavAgnim |
ye sehurAttAyatashastravegaM; te rAjaputrA nihatAH pramAdAt
shlokas.22:
na hi pramattena nareNa labhyA; vidyA tapaH shrIrvipulaM yasho vA |
pashyApramAdena nihatya shatrU;nsarvAnmahendraM sukhamedhamAnam
shlokas.23:
indropamAnpArthivaputrapautrA;npashyAvisheSheNa hatAnpramAdAt |
tIrtvA samudraM vaNijaH samRRiddhAH; sannAH kunadyAmiva helamAnAH
amarShitairye nihatAH shayAnA; niHsa.nshayaM te tridivaM prapannAH
shlokas.24:
kRRiShNAM nu shochAmi kathaM na sAdhvIM; shokArNave sAdya vina~NkShyatIti |
bhrAtR^I.nshcha putrA.nshcha hatAnnishamya; pA~nchAlarAjaM pitaraM cha vRRiddham
dhruvaM visa~nj~nA patitA pRRithivyAM; sA sheShyate shokakRRishA~NgayaShTiH
shlokas.25:
tachChokajaM duHkhamapArayantI; kathaM bhaviShyatyuchitA sukhAnAm |
putrakShayabhrAtRRivadhapraNunnA; pradahyamAneva hutAshanena
shlokas.26:
ityevamArtaH paridevayansa; rAjA kurUNAM nakulaM babhAShe |
gachChAnayainAmiha mandabhAgyAM; samAtRRipakShAmiti rAjaputrIm
shlokas.27:
mAdrIsutastatparigRRihya vAkyaM; dharmeNa dharmapratimasya rAj~naH |
yayau rathenAlayamAshu devyAH; pA~nchAlarAjasya cha yatra dArAH
shlokas.28:
prasthApya mAdrIsutamAjamIDhaH; shokArditastaiH sahitaH suhRRidbhiH |
rorUyamANaH prayayau sutAnA;mAyodhanaM bhUtagaNAnukIrNam
shlokas.29:
sa tatpravishyAshivamugrarUpaM; dadarsha putrAnsuhRRidaH sakhI.nshcha |
bhUmau shayAnAnrudhirArdragAtrA;nvibhinnabhagnApahRRitottamA~NgAn
shlokas.30:
sa tA.nstu dRRiShTvA bhRRishamArtarUpo; yudhiShThiro dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH |
uchchaiH prachukrosha cha kauravAgryaH; papAta chorvyAM sagaNo visa~nj~naH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa dRRiShTvA nihatAnsa~Nkhye putrAnbhrAtR^InsakhI.nstathA |
mahAduHkhaparItAtmA babhUva janamejaya
shlokas.2:
tatastasya mahA~nshokaH prAdurAsInmahAtmanaH |
smarataH putrapautrANAM bhrAtR^INAM svajanasya ha
shlokas.3:
tamashruparipUrNAkShaM vepamAnamachetasam |
suhRRido bhRRishasa.nvignAH sAntvayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.4:
tatastasminkShaNe kAlye rathenAdityavarchasA |
nakulaH kRRiShNayA sArdhamupAyAtparamArtayA
shlokas.5:
upaplavyagatA sA tu shrutvA sumahadapriyam |
tadA vinAshaM putrANAM sarveShAM vyathitAbhavat
shlokas.6:
kampamAneva kadalI vAtenAbhisamIritA |
kRRiShNA rAjAnamAsAdya shokArtA nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.7:
babhUva vadanaM tasyAH sahasA shokakarshitam |
phullapadmapalAshAkShyAstamodhvasta ivA.nshumAn
shlokas.8:
tatastAM patitAM dRRiShTvA sa.nrambhI satyavikramaH |
bAhubhyAM parijagrAha samupetya vRRikodaraH
shlokas.9:
sA samAshvAsitA tena bhImasenena bhAminI |
rudatI pANDavaM kRRiShNA sahabhrAtaramabravIt
shlokas.10:
diShTyA rAja.nstvamadyemAmakhilAM bhokShyase mahIm |
AtmajAnkShatradharmeNa sampradAya yamAya vai
shlokas.11:
diShTyA tvaM pArtha kushalI mattamAta~NgagAminam |
avApya pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM saubhadraM na smariShyasi
shlokas.12:
AtmajA.nstena dharmeNa shrutvA shUrAnnipAtitAn |
upaplavye mayA sArdhaM diShTyA tvaM na smariShyasi
shlokas.13:
prasuptAnAM vadhaM shrutvA drauNinA pApakarmaNA |
shokastapati mAM pArtha hutAshana ivAshayam
shlokas.14:
tasya pApakRRito drauNerna chedadya tvayA mRRidhe |
hriyate sAnubandhasya yudhi vikramya jIvitam
shlokas.15:
ihaiva prAyamAsiShye tannibodhata pANDavAH |
na chetphalamavApnoti drauNiH pApasya karmaNaH
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA tataH kRRiShNA pANDavaM pratyupAvishat |
yudhiShThiraM yAj~nasenI dharmarAjaM yashasvinI
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvopaviShTAM rAjarShiH pANDavo mahiShIM priyAm |
pratyuvAcha sa dharmAtmA draupadIM chArudarshanAm
shlokas.18:
dharmyaM dharmeNa dharmaj~ne prAptAste nidhanaM shubhe |
putrAste bhrAtarashchaiva tAnna shochitumarhasi
shlokas.19:
droNaputraH sa kalyANi vanaM dUramito gataH |
tasya tvaM pAtanaM sa~Nkhye kathaM j~nAsyasi shobhane
shlokas.20:
draupadyuvAcha||
droNaputrasya sahajo maNiH shirasi me shrutaH |
nihatya sa~Nkhye taM pApaM pashyeyaM maNimAhRRitam
rAja~nshirasi taM kRRitvA jIveyamiti me matiH
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA pANDavaM kRRiShNA rAjAnaM chArudarshanA |
bhImasenamathAbhyetya kupitA vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.22:
trAtumarhasi mAM bhIma kShatradharmamanusmaran |
jahi taM pApakarmANaM shambaraM maghavAniva
na hi te vikrame tulyaH pumAnastIha kashchana
shlokas.23:
shrutaM tatsarvalokeShu paramavyasane yathA |
dvIpo.abhUstvaM hi pArthAnAM nagare vAraNAvate
hiDimbadarshane chaiva tathA tvamabhavo gatiH
shlokas.24:
tathA virATanagare kIchakena bhRRishArditAm |
mAmapyuddhRRitavAnkRRichChrAtpaulomIM maghavAniva
shlokas.25:
yathaitAnyakRRithAH pArtha mahAkarmANi vai purA |
tathA drauNimamitraghna vinihatya sukhI bhava
shlokas.26:
tasyA bahuvidhaM duHkhAnnishamya paridevitam |
nAmarShayata kaunteyo bhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.27:
sa kA~nchanavichitrA~NgamAruroha mahAratham |
AdAya ruchiraM chitraM samArgaNaguNaM dhanuH
shlokas.28:
nakulaM sArathiM kRRitvA droNaputravadhe vRRitaH |
visphArya sasharaM chApaM tUrNamashvAnachodayat
shlokas.29:
te hayAH puruShavyAghra choditA vAtaraMhasaH |
vegena tvaritA jagmurharayaH shIghragAminaH
shlokas.30:
shibirAtsvAdgRRihItvA sa rathasya padamachyutaH |
droNaputrarathasyAshu yayau mArgeNa vIryavAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminprayAte durdharShe yadUnAmRRiShabhastataH |
abravItpuNDarIkAkShaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
eSha pANDava te bhrAtA putrashokamapArayan |
jighA.nsurdrauNimAkrande yAti bhArata bhArataH
shlokas.3:
bhImaH priyaste sarvebhyo bhrAtRRibhyo bharatarShabha |
taM kRRichChragatamadya tvaM kasmAnnAbhyavapadyase
shlokas.4:
yattadAchaShTa putrAya droNaH parapura~njayaH |
astraM brahmashiro nAma dahedyatpRRithivImapi
shlokas.5:
tanmahAtmA mahAbhAgaH ketuH sarvadhanuShmatAm |
pratyapAdayadAchAryaH prIyamANo dhana~njayam
shlokas.7:
viditaM chApalaM hyAsIdAtmajasya mahAtmanaH |
sarvadharmavidAchAryo nAnviShatsatataM sutam
shlokas.8:
paramApadgatenApi na sma tAta tvayA raNe |
idamastraM prayoktavyaM mAnuSheShu visheShataH
shlokas.9:
ityuktavAnguruH putraM droNaH pashchAdathoktavAn |
na tvaM jAtu satAM mArge sthAteti puruSharShabha
shlokas.10:
sa tadAj~nAya duShTAtmA piturvachanamapriyam |
nirAshaH sarvakalyANaiH shochanparyapatanmahIm
shlokas.11:
tatastadA kurushreShTha vanasthe tvayi bhArata |
avasaddvArakAmetya vRRiShNibhiH paramArchitaH
shlokas.12:
sa kadAchitsamudrAnte vasandrAravatImanu |
eka ekaM samAgamya mAmuvAcha hasanniva
shlokas.13:
yattadugraM tapaH kRRiShNa charansatyaparAkramaH |
agastyAdbhAratAchAryaH pratyapadyata me pitA
shlokas.14:
astraM brahmashiro nAma devagandharvapUjitam |
tadadya mayi dAshArha yathA pitari me tathA
shlokas.15:
asmattastadupAdAya divyamastraM yadUttama |
mamApyastraM prayachCha tvaM chakraM ripuharaM raNe
shlokas.16:
sa rAjanprIyamANena mayApyuktaH kRRitA~njaliH |
yAchamAnaH prayatnena matto.astraM bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
devadAnavagandharvamanuShyapatagoragAH |
na samA mama vIryasya shatA.nshenApi piNDitAH
shlokas.18:
idaM dhanuriyaM shaktiridaM chakramiyaM gadA |
yadyadichChasi chedastraM mattastattaddadAni te
shlokas.19:
yachChaknoShi samudyantuM prayoktumapi vA raNe |
tadgRRihANa vinAstreNa yanme dAtumabhIpsasi
shlokas.20:
sa sunAbhaM sahasrAraM vajranAbhamayasmayam |
vavre chakraM mahAbAho spardhamAno mayA saha
shlokas.21:
gRRihANa chakramityukto mayA tu tadanantaram |
jagrAhopetya sahasA chakraM savyena pANinA
na chaitadashakatsthAnAtsa~nchAlayitumachyuta
shlokas.22:
atha taddakShiNenApi grahItumupachakrame |
sarvayatnena tenApi gRRihNannetadakalpayat
shlokas.23:
tataH sarvabalenApi yachchaitanna shashAka saH |
uddhartuM vA chAlayituM drauNiH paramadurmanAH
kRRitvA yatnaM paraM shrAntaH sa nyavartata bhArata
shlokas.25:
yaH sa devamanuShyeShu pramANaM paramaM gataH |
gANDIvadhanvA shvetAshvaH kapipravaraketanaH
shlokas.26:
yaH sAkShAddevadeveshaM shitikaNThamumApatim |
dva.ndvayuddhe parAjiShNustoShayAmAsa sha~Nkaram
shlokas.27:
yasmAtpriyataro nAsti mamAnyaH puruSho bhuvi |
nAdeyaM yasya me ki~nchidapi dArAH sutAstathA
shlokas.28:
tenApi suhRRidA brahmanpArthenAkliShTakarmaNA |
noktapurvamidaM vAkyaM yattvaM mAmabhibhAShase
shlokas.29:
brahmacharyaM mahadghoraM chIrtvA dvAdashavArShikam |
himavatpArshvamabhyetya yo mayA tapasArchitaH
shlokas.30:
samAnavratachAriNyAM rukmiNyAM yo.anvajAyata |
sanatkumArastejasvI pradyumno nAma me sutaH
shlokas.31:
tenApyetanmahaddivyaM chakramapratimaM mama |
na prArthitamabhUnmUDha yadidaM prArthitaM tvayA
shlokas.32:
rAmeNAtibalenaitannoktapUrvaM kadAchana |
na gadena na sAmbena yadidaM prArthitaM tvayA
shlokas.34:
bhAratAchAryaputraH sanmAnitaH sarvayAdavaiH |
chakreNa rathinAM shreShTha kiM nu tAta yuyutsase
shlokas.35:
evamukto mayA drauNirmAmidaM pratyuvAcha ha |
prayujya bhavate pUjAM yotsye kRRiShNa tvayetyuta
shlokas.36:
tataste prArthitaM chakraM devadAnavapUjitam |
ajeyaH syAmiti vibho satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.37:
tvatto.ahaM durlabhaM kAmamanavApyaiva keshava |
pratiyAsyAmi govinda shivenAbhivadasva mAm
shlokas.38:
etatsunAbhaM vRRiShNInAmRRiShabheNa tvayA dhRRitam |
chakramapratichakreNa bhuvi nAnyo.abhipadyate
shlokas.39:
etAvaduktvA drauNirmAM yugyamashvAndhanAni cha |
AdAyopayayau bAlo ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.40:
sa sa.nrambhI durAtmA cha chapalaH krUra eva cha |
veda chAstraM brahmashirastasmAdrakShyo vRRikodaraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA yudhAM shreShThaH sarvayAdavanandanaH |
sarvAyudhavaropetamAruroha mahAratham
yuktaM paramakAmbojaisturagairhemamAlibhiH
shlokas.2:
AdityodayavarNasya dhuraM rathavarasya tu |
dakShiNAmavahatsainyaH sugrIvaH savyato.avahat
pArShNivAhau tu tasyAstAM meghapuShpabalAhakau
shlokas.3:
vishvakarmakRRitA divyA nAnAratnavibhUShitA |
uchChriteva rathe mAyA dhvajayaShTiradRRishyata
shlokas.4:
vainateyaH sthitastasyAM prabhAmaNDalarashmivAn |
tasya satyavataH keturbhujagAriradRRishyata
shlokas.5:
anvArohaddhRRiShIkeshaH ketuH sarvadhanuShmatAm |
arjunaH satyakarmA cha kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.6:
ashobhetAM mahAtmAnau dAshArhamabhitaH sthitau |
rathasthaM shAr~NgadhanvAnamashvinAviva vAsavam
shlokas.7:
tAvupAropya dAshArhaH syandanaM lokapUjitam |
pratodena javopetAnparamAshvAnachodayat
shlokas.8:
te hayAH sahasotpeturgRRihItvA syandanottamam |
AsthitaM pANDaveyAbhyAM yadUnAmRRiShabheNa cha
shlokas.9:
vahatAM shAr~NgadhanvAnamashvAnAM shIghragAminAm |
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdaH pakShiNAM patatAmiva
shlokas.10:
te samArChannaravyAghrAH kShaNena bharatarShabha |
bhImasenaM maheShvAsaM samanudrutya vegitAH
shlokas.11:
krodhadIptaM tu kaunteyaM dviShadarthe samudyatam |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM sametyApi mahArathAH
shlokas.12:
sa teShAM prekShatAmeva shrImatAM dRRiDhadhanvinAm |
yayau bhAgirathIkachChaM haribhirbhRRishavegitaiH
yatra sma shrUyate drauNiH putrahantA mahAtmanAm
shlokas.13:
sa dadarsha mahAtmAnamudakAnte yashasvinam |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM vyAsamAsInamRRiShibhiH saha
shlokas.14:
taM chaiva krUrakarmANaM ghRRitAktaM kushachIriNam |
rajasA dhvastakeshAntaM dadarsha drauNimantike
shlokas.15:
tamabhyadhAvatkaunteyaH pragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH |
bhImaseno mahAbAhustiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.16:
sa dRRiShTvA bhImadhanvAnaM pragRRihItasharAsanam |
bhrAtarau pRRiShThatashchAsya janArdanarathe sthitau
vyathitAtmAbhavaddrauNiH prAptaM chedamamanyata
shlokas.17:
sa taddivyamadInAtmA paramAstramachintayat |
jagrAha cha sa chaiShIkAM drauNiH savyena pANinA
sa tAmApadamAsAdya divyamastramudIrayat
shlokas.19:
ityuktvA rAjashArdUla droNaputraH pratApavAn |
sarvalokapramohArthaM tadastraM pramumocha ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
i~Ngitenaiva dAshArhastamabhiprAyamAditaH |
drauNerbuddhvA mahAbAhurarjunaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
arjunArjuna yaddivyamastraM te hRRidi vartate |
droNopadiShTaM tasyAyaM kAlaH samprati pANDava
shlokas.4:
keshavenaivamuktastu pANDavaH paravIrahA |
avAtaradrathAttUrNaM pragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.5:
pUrvamAchAryaputrAya tato.anantaramAtmane |
bhrAtRRibhyashchaiva sarvebhyaH svastItyuktvA parantapaH
shlokas.6:
devatAbhyo namaskRRitya gurubhyashchaiva sarvashaH |
utsasarja shivaM dhyAyannastramastreNa shAmyatAm
shlokas.7:
tatastadastraM sahasA sRRiShTaM gANDIvadhanvanA |
prajajvAla mahArchiShmadyugAntAnalasaMnibham
shlokas.8:
tathaiva droNaputrasya tadastraM tigmatejasaH |
prajajvAla mahAjvAlaM tejomaNDalasa.nvRRitam
shlokas.9:
nirghAtA bahavashchAsanpeturulkAH sahasrashaH |
mahadbhayaM cha bhUtAnAM sarveShAM samajAyata
shlokas.10:
sashabdamabhavadvyoma jvAlAmAlAkulaM bhRRisham |
chachAla cha mahI kRRitsnA saparvatavanadrumA
shlokas.11:
te astre tejasA lokA.nstApayantI vyavasthite |
maharShI sahitau tatra darshayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.12:
nAradaH sa cha dharmAtmA bharatAnAM pitAmahaH |
ubhau shamayituM vIrau bhAradvAjadhana~njayau
shlokas.13:
tau munI sarvadharmaj~nau sarvabhUtahitaiShiNau |
dIptayorastrayormadhye sthitau paramatejasau
shlokas.14:
tadantaramanAdhRRiShyAvupagamya yashasvinau |
AstAmRRiShivarau tatra jvalitAviva pAvakau
shlokas.15:
prANabhRRidbhiranAdhRRiShyau devadAnavasaMmatau |
astratejaH shamayituM lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.16:
RRiShI UchatuH||
nAnAshastravidaH pUrve ye.apyatItA mahArathAH |
naitadastraM manuShyeShu taiH prayuktaM katha~nchana

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dRRiShTvaiva narashArdUlastAvagnisamatejasau |
sa~njahAra sharaM divyaM tvaramANo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
uvAcha vadatAM shreShThastAvRRiShI prA~njalistadA |
prayuktamastramastreNa shAmyatAmiti vai mayA
shlokas.3:
saMhRRite paramAstre.asminsarvAnasmAnasheShataH |
pApakarmA dhruvaM drauNiH pradhakShyatyastratejasA
shlokas.4:
atra yaddhitamasmAkaM lokAnAM chaiva sarvathA |
bhavantau devasa~NkAshau tathA saMhartumarhataH
shlokas.5:
ityuktvA sa~njahArAstraM punareva dhana~njayaH |
saMhAro duShkarastasya devairapi hi sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
visRRiShTasya raNe tasya paramAstrasya sa~Ngrahe |
na shaktaH pANDavAdanyaH sAkShAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.7:
brahmatejobhavaM taddhi visRRiShTamakRRitAtmanA |
na shakyamAvartayituM brahmachArivratAdRRite
shlokas.8:
achIrNabrahmacharyo yaH sRRiShTvAvartayate punaH |
tadastraM sAnubandhasya mUrdhAnaM tasya kRRintati
shlokas.9:
brahmachArI vratI chApi duravApamavApya tat |
paramavyasanArto.api nArjuno.astraM vyamu~nchata
shlokas.10:
satyavratadharaH shUro brahmachArI cha pANDavaH |
guruvartI cha tenAstraM sa~njahArArjunaH punaH
shlokas.11:
drauNirapyatha samprekShya tAvRRiShI purataH sthitau |
na shashAka punarghoramastraM saMhartumAhave
shlokas.12:
ashaktaH pratisaMhAre paramAstrasya sa.nyuge |
drauNirdInamanA rAjandvaipAyanamabhAShata
shlokas.14:
adharmashcha kRRito.anena dhArtarAShTraM jighA.nsatA |
mithyAchAreNa bhagavanbhImasenena sa.nyuge
shlokas.15:
ataH sRRiShTamidaM brahmanmayAstramakRRitAtmanA |
tasya bhUyo.adya saMhAraM kartuM nAhamihotsahe
shlokas.16:
visRRiShTaM hi mayA divyametadastraM durAsadam |
apANDavAyeti mune vahnitejo.anumantrya vai
shlokas.18:
kRRitaM pApamidaM brahmanroShAviShTena chetasA |
vadhamAshAsya pArthAnAM mayAstraM sRRijatA raNe
shlokas.19:
vyAsa uvAcha||
astraM brahmashirastAta vidvAnpArtho dhana~njayaH |
utsRRiShTavAnna roSheNa na vadhAya tavAhave
shlokas.20:
astramastreNa tu raNe tava sa.nshamayiShyatA |
visRRiShTamarjunenedaM punashcha pratisaMhRRitam
shlokas.22:
evaM dhRRitimataH sAdhoH sarvAstraviduShaH sataH |
sabhrAtRRibandhoH kasmAttvaM vadhamasya chikIrShasi
shlokas.23:
astraM brahmashiro yatra paramAstreNa vadhyate |
samA dvAdasha parjanyastadrAShTraM nAbhivarShati
shlokas.24:
etadarthaM mahAbAhuH shaktimAnapi pANDavaH |
na vihantyetadastraM te prajAhitachikIrShayA
shlokas.25:
pANDavAstvaM cha rAShTraM cha sadA sa.nrakShyameva naH |
tasmAtsaMhara divyaM tvamastrametanmahAbhuja
shlokas.26:
aroShastava chaivAstu pArthAH santu nirAmayAH |
na hyadharmeNa rAjarShiH pANDavo jetumichChati
shlokas.27:
maNiM chaitaM prayachChaibhyo yaste shirasi tiShThati |
etadAdAya te prANAnpratidAsyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.28:
drauNiruvAcha||
pANDavairyAni ratnAni yachchAnyatkauravairdhanam |
avAptAnIha tebhyo.ayaM maNirmama vishiShyate
shlokas.29:
yamAbadhya bhayaM nAsti shastravyAdhikShudhAshrayam |
devebhyo dAnavebhyo vA nAgebhyo vA katha~nchana
shlokas.30:
na cha rakShogaNabhayaM na taskarabhayaM tathA |
eva.nvIryo maNirayaM na me tyAjyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.31:
yattu me bhagavAnAha tanme kAryamanantaram |
ayaM maNirayaM chAhamiShIkA nipatiShyati
garbheShu pANDaveyAnAmamoghaM chaitadudyatam
shlokas.32:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evaM kuru na chAnyA te buddhiH kAryA kadAchana |
garbheShu pANDaveyAnAM visRRijyaitadupArama
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH paramamastraM tadashvatthAmA bhRRishAturaH |
dvaipAyanavachaH shrutvA garbheShu pramumocha ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tadAj~nAya hRRiShIkesho visRRiShTaM pApakarmaNA |
hRRiShyamANa idaM vAkyaM drauNiM pratyabravIttadA
shlokas.2:
virATasya sutAM pUrvaM snuShAM gANDIvadhanvanaH |
upaplavyagatAM dRRiShTvA vratavAnbrAhmaNo.abravIt
shlokas.3:
parikShINeShu kuruShu putrastava janiShyati |
etadasya parikShittvaM garbhasthasya bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
tasya tadvachanaM sAdhoH satyameva bhaviShyati |
parikShidbhavitA hyeShAM punarva.nshakaraH sutaH
shlokas.5:
evaM bruvANaM govindaM sAtvatapravaraM tadA |
drauNiH paramasa.nrabdhaH pratyuvAchedamuttaram
shlokas.6:
naitadevaM yathAttha tvaM pakShapAtena keshava |
vachanaM puNDarIkAkSha na cha madvAkyamanyathA
shlokas.7:
patiShyatyetadastraM hi garbhe tasyA mayodyatam |
virATaduhituH kRRiShNa yAM tvaM rakShitumichChasi
shlokas.8:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
amoghaH paramAstrasya pAtastasya bhaviShyati |
sa tu garbho mRRito jAto dIrghamAyuravApsyati
shlokas.9:
tvAM tu kApuruShaM pApaM viduH sarve manIShiNaH |
asakRRitpApakarmANaM bAlajIvitaghAtakam
shlokas.10:
tasmAttvamasya pApasya karmaNaH phalamApnuhi |
trINi varShasahasrANi chariShyasi mahImimAm
aprApnuvankvachitkA~nchitsa.nvidaM jAtu kenachit
shlokas.11:
nirjanAnasahAyastvaM deshAnpravichariShyasi |
bhavitrI na hi te kShudra janamadhyeShu sa.nsthitiH
shlokas.13:
vayaH prApya parikShittu vedavratamavApya cha |
kRRipAchChAradvatAdvIraH sarvAstrANyupalapsyate
shlokas.14:
viditvA paramAstrANi kShatradharmavrate sthitaH |
ShaShTiM varShANi dharmAtmA vasudhAM pAlayiShyati
shlokas.15:
itashchordhvaM mahAbAhuH kururAjo bhaviShyati |
parikShinnAma nRRipatirmiShataste sudurmate
pashya me tapaso vIryaM satyasya cha narAdhama
shlokas.16:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yasmAdanAdRRitya kRRitaM tvayAsmAnkarma dAruNam |
brAhmaNasya satashchaiva yasmAtte vRRittamIdRRisham
shlokas.17:
tasmAdyaddevakIputra uktavAnuttamaM vachaH |
asa.nshayaM te tadbhAvi kShudrakarmanvrajAshvitaH
shlokas.18:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
sahaiva bhavatA brahmansthAsyAmi puruSheShvaham |
satyavAgastu bhagavAnayaM cha puruShottamaH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pradAyAtha maNiM drauNiH pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
jagAma vimanAsteShAM sarveShAM pashyatAM vanam
shlokas.20:
pANDavAshchApi govindaM puraskRRitya hatadviShaH |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM chaiva nAradaM cha mahAmunim
shlokas.21:
droNaputrasya sahajaM maNimAdAya satvarAH |
draupadImabhyadhAvanta prAyopetAM manasvinIm
shlokas.22:
tataste puruShavyAghrAH sadashvairanilopamaiH |
abhyayuH sahadAshArhAH shibiraM punareva ha
shlokas.23:
avatIrya rathAbhyAM tu tvaramANA mahArathAH |
dadRRishurdraupadIM kRRiShNAmArtAmArtatarAH svayam
shlokas.24:
tAmupetya nirAnandAM duHkhashokasamanvitAm |
parivArya vyatiShThanta pANDavAH sahakeshavAH
shlokas.25:
tato rAj~nAbhyanuj~nAto bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
pradadau tu maNiM divyaM vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.26:
ayaM bhadre tava maNiH putrahantA jitaH sa te |
uttiShTha shokamutsRRijya kShatradharmamanusmara
shlokas.27:
prayANe vAsudevasya shamArthamasitekShaNe |
yAnyuktAni tvayA bhIru vAkyAni madhughAtinaH
shlokas.28:
naiva me patayaH santi na putrA bhrAtaro na cha |
naiva tvamapi govinda shamamichChati rAjani
shlokas.29:
uktavatyasi dhIrANi vAkyAni puruShottamam |
kShatradharmAnurUpANi tAni sa.nsmartumarhasi
shlokas.30:
hato duryodhanaH pApo rAjyasya paripanthakaH |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pItaM visphurato mayA
shlokas.31:
vairasya gatamAnRRiNyaM na sma vAchyA vivakShatAm |
jitvA mukto droNaputro brAhmaNyAdgauraveNa cha
shlokas.32:
yasho.asya pAtitaM devi sharIraM tvavasheShitam |
viyojitashcha maNinA nyAsitashchAyudhaM bhuvi
shlokas.33:
draupadyuvAcha||
kevalAnRRiNyamAptAsmi guruputro gururmama |
shirasyetaM maNiM rAjA pratibadhnAtu bhArata
shlokas.34:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM gRRihItvA tato rAjA shirasyevAkarottadA |
guroruchChiShTamityeva draupadyA vachanAdapi
shlokas.35:
tato divyaM maNivaraM shirasA dhArayanprabhuH |
shushubhe sa mahArAjaH sachandra iva parvataH
shlokas.36:
uttasthau putrashokArtA tataH kRRiShNA manasvinI |
kRRiShNaM chApi mahAbAhuM paryapRRichChata dharmarAT

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hateShu sarvasainyeShu sauptike tai rathaistribhiH |
shochanyudhiShThiro rAjA dAshArhamidamabravIt
shlokas.2:
kathaM nu kRRiShNa pApena kShudreNAkliShTakarmaNA |
drauNinA nihatAH sarve mama putrA mahArathAH
shlokas.3:
tathA kRRitAstrA vikrAntAH sahasrashatayodhinaH |
drupadasyAtmajAshchaiva droNaputreNa pAtitAH
shlokas.4:
yasya droNo maheShvAso na prAdAdAhave mukham |
taM jaghne rathinAM shreShThaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM kathaM nu saH
shlokas.5:
kiM nu tena kRRitaM karma tathAyuktaM nararShabha |
yadekaH shibiraM sarvamavadhInno guroH sutaH
shlokas.6:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
nUnaM sa devadevAnAmIshvareshvaramavyayam |
jagAma sharaNaM drauNirekastenAvadhIdbahUn
shlokas.7:
prasanno hi mahAdevo dadyAdamaratAmapi |
vIryaM cha girisho dadyAdyenendramapi shAtayet
shlokas.8:
vedAhaM hi mahAdevaM tattvena bharatarShabha |
yAni chAsya purANAni karmANi vividhAnyuta
shlokas.9:
AdireSha hi bhUtAnAM madhyamantashcha bhArata |
vicheShTate jagachchedaM sarvamasyaiva karmaNA
shlokas.10:
evaM sisRRikShurbhUtAni dadarsha prathamaM vibhuH |
pitAmaho.abravIchchainaM bhUtAni sRRija mAchiram
shlokas.11:
harikeshastathetyuktvA bhUtAnAM doShadarshivAn |
dIrghakAlaM tapastepe magno.ambhasi mahAtapAH
shlokas.12:
sumahAntaM tataH kAlaM pratIkShyainaM pitAmahaH |
sraShTAraM sarvabhUtAnAM sasarja manasAparam
shlokas.13:
so.abravItpitaraM dRRiShTvA girishaM magnamambhasi |
yadi me nAgrajastvanyastataH srakShyAmyahaM prajAH
shlokas.14:
tamabravItpitA nAsti tvadanyaH puruSho.agrajaH |
sthANureSha jale magno visrabdhaH kuru vai kRRitim
shlokas.15:
sa bhUtAnyasRRijatsapta dakShAdI.nstu prajApatIn |
yairimaM vyakarotsarvaM bhUtagrAmaM chaturvidham
shlokas.16:
tAH sRRiShTamAtrAH kShudhitAH prajAH sarvAH prajApatim |
bibhakShayiShavo rAjansahasA prAdrava.nstadA
shlokas.17:
sa bhakShyamANastrANArthI pitAmahamupAdravat |
Abhyo mAM bhagavAnpAtu vRRittirAsAM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.18:
tatastAbhyo dadAvannamoShadhIH sthAvarANi cha |
ja~NgamAni cha bhUtAni durbalAni balIyasAm
shlokas.19:
vihitAnnAH prajAstAstu jagmustuShTA yathAgatam |
tato vavRRidhire rAjanprItimatyaH svayoniShu
shlokas.20:
bhUtagrAme vivRRiddhe tu tuShTe lokagurAvapi |
udatiShThajjalAjjyeShThaH prajAshchemA dadarsha saH
shlokas.21:
bahurUpAH prajA dRRiShTvA vivRRiddhAH svena tejasA |
chukrodha bhagavAnrudro li~NgaM svaM chApyavidhyata
shlokas.22:
tatpraviddhaM tadA bhUmau tathaiva pratyatiShThata |
tamuvAchAvyayo brahmA vachobhiH shamayanniva
shlokas.23:
kiM kRRitaM salile sharva chirakAlaM sthitena te |
kimarthaM chaitadutpATya bhUmau li~NgaM praveritam
shlokas.24:
so.abravIjjAtasa.nrambhastadA lokagururgurum |
prajAH sRRiShTAH pareNemAH kiM kariShyAmyanena vai
shlokas.25:
tapasAdhigataM chAnnaM prajArthaM me pitAmaha |
oShadhyaH parivarteranyathaiva satataM prajAH
shlokas.26:
evamuktvA tu sa~Nkruddho jagAma vimanA bhavaH |
girermu~njavataH pAdaM tapastaptuM mahAtapAH

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tato devayuge.atIte devA vai samakalpayan |
yaj~naM vedapramANena vidhivadyaShTumIpsavaH
shlokas.2:
kalpayAmAsuravyagrA deshAnyaj~nochitA.nstataH |
bhAgArhA devatAshchaiva yaj~niyaM dravyameva cha
shlokas.3:
tA vai rudramajAnantyo yAthAtathyena devatAH |
nAkalpayanta devasya sthANorbhAgaM narAdhipa
shlokas.4:
so.akalpyamAne bhAge tu kRRittivAsA makhe.amaraiH |
tarasA bhAgamanvichChandhanurAdau sasarja ha
shlokas.5:
lokayaj~naH kriyAyaj~no gRRihayaj~naH sanAtanaH |
pa~nchabhUtamayo yaj~no nRRiyaj~nashchaiva pa~nchamaH
shlokas.6:
lokayaj~nena yaj~naiShI kapardI vidadhe dhanuH |
dhanuH sRRiShTamabhUttasya pa~nchakiShkupramANataH
shlokas.7:
vaShaTkAro.abhavajjyA tu dhanuShastasya bhArata |
yaj~nA~NgAni cha chatvAri tasya saMhanane.abhavan
shlokas.8:
tataH kruddho mahAdevastadupAdAya kArmukam |
AjagAmAtha tatraiva yatra devAH samIjire
shlokas.9:
tamAttakArmukaM dRRiShTvA brahmachAriNamavyayam |
vivyathe pRRithivI devI parvatAshcha chakampire
shlokas.10:
na vavau pavanashchaiva nAgnirjajvAla chaidhitaH |
vyabhramachchApi sa.nvignaM divi nakShatramaNDalam
shlokas.11:
na babhau bhAskarashchApi somaH shrImuktamaNDalaH |
timireNAkulaM sarvamAkAshaM chAbhavadvRRitam
shlokas.12:
abhibhUtAstato devA viShayAnna prajaj~nire |
na pratyabhAchcha yaj~nastAnvedA babhra.nshire tadA
shlokas.13:
tataH sa yaj~naM raudreNa vivyAdha hRRidi patriNA |
apakrAntastato yaj~no mRRigo bhUtvA sapAvakaH
shlokas.14:
sa tu tenaiva rUpeNa divaM prApya vyarochata |
anvIyamAno rudreNa yudhiShThira nabhastale
shlokas.15:
apakrAnte tato yaj~ne sa~nj~nA na pratyabhAtsurAn |
naShTasa~nj~neShu deveShu na praj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.16:
tryambakaH saviturbAhU bhagasya nayane tathA |
pUShNashcha dashanAnkruddho dhanuShkoTyA vyashAtayat
shlokas.17:
prAdravanta tato devA yaj~nA~NgAni cha sarvashaH |
kechittatraiva ghUrNanto gatAsava ivAbhavan
shlokas.18:
sa tu vidrAvya tatsarvaM shitikaNTho.avahasya cha |
avaShTabhya dhanuShkoTiM rurodha vibudhA.nstataH
shlokas.19:
tato vAgamarairuktA jyAM tasya dhanuSho.achChinat |
atha tatsahasA rAja.nshChinnajyaM visphuraddhanuH
shlokas.20:
tato vidhanuShaM devA devashreShThamupAgaman |
sharaNaM saha yaj~nena prasAdaM chAkarotprabhuH
shlokas.21:
tataH prasanno bhagavAnprAsyatkopaM jalAshaye |
sa jalaM pAvako bhUtvA shoShayatyanishaM prabho
shlokas.22:
bhagasya nayane chaiva bAhU cha savitustathA |
prAdAtpUShNashcha dashanAnpunaryaj~naM cha pANDava
shlokas.23:
tataH sarvamidaM svasthaM babhUva punareva ha |
sarvANi cha havIMShyasya devA bhAgamakalpayan
shlokas.24:
tasminkruddhe.abhavatsarvamasvasthaM bhuvanaM vibho |
prasanne cha punaH svasthaM sa prasanno.asya vIryavAn
shlokas.25:
tataste nihatAH sarve tava putrA mahArathAH |
anye cha bahavaH shUrAH pA~nchAlAshcha sahAnugAH
shlokas.26:
na tanmanasi kartavyaM na hi taddrauNinA kRRitam |
mahAdevaprasAdaH sa kuru kAryamanantaram
